items.titleEn: Each team's best single-game performance of '26
bodyEn: A 10-RBI game? Three home runs in a historic MLB debut? A one-hit shutout with 15 strikeouts?
All of those single-game feats happened in 2026, a memorable season in which MLB hitters combined for four cycles and 16 three-homer games, while MLB pitchers totaled 29 games of 12 or more K’s.

Those are just a few of the performances that stand out from another rollicking season of baseball. Here is a look back at each team’s best individual single-game performance of 2026, with an honorable mention listed for each club.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
American League East
Blue Jays: Dylan CeaseJuly 8 at SF (8 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 11 K)

Dave Stieb stands alone as the only pitcher in Blue Jays history to throw a no-hitter, but Cease knocked on the doorstep on a Wednesday afternoon in San Francisco. Although Cease needed 115 pitches to hold the Giants hitless through eight innings, he bounded out of the dugout to take the mound for the ninth anyway. The effort was short-lived, as Heliot Ramos banged a 1-1 fastball into center field to end Cease’s bid at history. But Cease – who was not yet born when Stieb threw his no-hitter – still provided one of the best pitching performances by anyone to wear a Blue Jays uniform (and, it should be noted, the honorable mention belongs in that category, too).
Honorable mention: Cease, July 25 at BOS (9 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 12 K)
Orioles: Gunnar HendersonAug. 30 at ATH (4-for-4, 2 HR, 5 RBIs)

It may have been a down year for Henderson, but the uber-talented shortstop put his full talent on display on this particular day against the A’s. Fueled by two home runs and a triple, Henderson recorded 12 total bases, the most by an Orioles player since Ryan Mountcastle notched 13 total bases on June 19, 2021. Henderson also helped the O’s to a win, making three sublime defensive plays at shortstop.
Honorable mention: Pete Alonso, Aug. 9 at TEX (3-for-3, 2 HR, 4 RBIs, 2 BBs)
Rays: Drew RasmussenAL Division Series Game 1 vs. NYY (8 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 10 K)

Rasmussen kickstarted a thrilling October for the Rays with one of the greatest pitching performances in franchise history, blanking the Yankees across eight innings of one-hit ball in a narrow 1-0 victory. He became just the seventh pitcher in postseason history to take a no-hit bid at least 7 2/3 innings and the first since Aníbal Sánchez in Game 1 of the 2019 NLCS. Rasmussen’s 10 strikeouts were tied for the most in a postseason game by a Rays pitcher, joining Tyler Glasnow in Game 2 of the 2020 ALDS.
Honorable mention: Junior Caminero, June 25 vs. KC (3-for-5, 3 HR, 6 RBIs)
Red Sox: Ranger SuarezApril 27 at TOR (8 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 10 K)

Suarez did not waste much time showing why the Red Sox signed him to a five-year, $130 million deal last offseason. In his sixth start with Boston, the steely left-hander delivered eight scoreless innings against the defending AL champions, notching 10 strikeouts. Suarez did not allow a base hit until Jesús Sánchez snuck a single inside the third-base bag leading off the sixth inning.
Honorable mention: Payton Tolle, Aug. 7 vs. ATH (6 IP, 2 H, 1 R, 14 K)
Yankees: Cam SchlittlerAL Wild Card Series Game 1 vs. BOS (6 1/3 IP, 2 H, 0 R, 10 K)

In one of the best seasons by a pitcher in the Yankees’ storied history, Schlittler once again saved his best for the postseason -- and, specifically, for the Red Sox. The AL Cy Young Award winner shut down Boston with a 10-strikeout gem over a career-high 117 pitches in Game 1 of the AL Wild Card Series, energizing the Bronx much like he did in his playoff debut a year earlier. Schlittler joined the legendary Bob Gibson as the only pitchers to record two 10-strikeout outings in the postseason against the Red Sox.
Honorable mention: Ben Rice, AL Wild Card Series Game 1 vs. BOS (4-for-5, 2 HR, 6 RBIs)
AL Central
Guardians: Gavin WilliamsSept. 1 vs. TOR (7 IP, 2 H, 0 ER, 13 K)

Williams led the AL with 248 strikeouts in 2026 thanks to performances such as the one he had against the Blue Jays to open September at Progressive Field. He didn’t allow a hit until the fourth inning, cruised through seven frames with only an unearned run allowed and finished with 13 K’s, the most by a Guardians starter in a game since Triston McKenzie in 2022.
Honorable mention: Travis Bazzana, June 20 at HOU (4-for-4, 2 HR, 5 RBIs)
Royals: Noah CameronAug. 16 at LAA (9 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 8 K)

Cameron was excellent for the Royals in 2025, finishing fourth in AL Rookie of the Year voting with a 2.99 ERA in 24 starts. He struggled early in ’26 but closed the year strong with a great second half, including a one-hit road shutout of the Angels in mid-August. The only hit the lefty allowed was a bloop single in the seventh, and he finished with K.C.’s first one-hitter since Zack Greinke in 2009.
Honorable mention: Jac Caglianone, Aug. 8 vs. CHC (4-for-4, 2 2B, 2 HR, 4 RBIs)
Tigers: Colt KeithJune 15 at HOU (3-for-4, 3 HR, 6 RBIs)

Keith’s lone multihomer game in 2026 was quite the effort: He launched three dingers in a 9-3 rout of the Astros. After being hit by a pitch with the bases loaded his first time up, Keith smacked a two-run tater in the third inning, another two-run shot in the seventh and a solo shot in the ninth. He finished with six RBIs, beating his previous career high (set in 2024) by two.
Honorable mention: Casey Mize, June 29 at NYY (7 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 10 K)
Twins: Bailey OberMay 12 vs. MIA (9 IP, 2 H, 0 R, 7 K)

Ober pitched the Twins’ first shutout since Pablo López in July 2023, blanking the Marlins at Target Field. He allowed a bunt single in the second inning and another base hit in the fourth, but that was all Miami could muster against the 6-foot-9 right-hander, who struck out seven without issuing a walk.
Honorable mention: Byron Buxton, April 14 vs. BOS (4-for-5, 2 HR)
White Sox: Tristan PetersJuly 10 vs. ATH (4-for-4, 2B, 3B, HR, 4 RBIs)

The 2026 season was a breakout year for Peters, who went from a onetime member of the Savannah Bananas to a key contributor for the White Sox. He etched his name into club history with a cycle against the Athletics, slugging a homer and a triple in the same seventh inning to complete the feat. One day later, Peters was named an All-Star for the first time in his career.
Honorable mention: Miguel Vargas, Aug. 14 at DET (4-for-5, 2B, 2 HR)
AL West
Angels: Zach NetoAug. 20 at HOU (5-for-6, 2B, HR, 7 RBIs)

Neto has blossomed into a dynamic shortstop for the Angels, and we saw that in full force on this day. Neto set a career high with five hits and seven RBIs, becoming the first player in Angels franchise history to achieve both of those feats in the same game.
Honorable mention: Reid Detmers, May 24 vs. TEX (8 IP, 1 H, 1 R, 14 K)
Astros: Lucas SpenceSept. 24 at ATH (3-for-4, 3 HR, 5 RBIs)

Entering this game, Spence hadn’t homered in his first 13 career MLB games in which he recorded a plate appearance. He proceeded to hit not one, not two, but three home runs in his game -- the first three homers of Spence’s career. Spence joined Yordan Alvarez as the only Astros rookies to homer three times in a game.
Honorable mention: Yordan Alvarez, July 4 vs. TB (3-for-4, 2 HR, 6 RBIs)
Athletics: J.T. GinnMay 18 at LAA (8 IP, 2 H, 2 R, 10 K)

Ginn carried a no-hitter into the ninth inning in Anaheim, setting himself up for history before an unfortunate ending. The A’s righty lost his no-hitter to begin the ninth inning, and Zach Neto followed with a walk-off two-run homer. Nonetheless, Ginn tossed eight innings of two-run ball and struck out 10 batters.
Honorable mention: Nick Kurtz, June 15 vs. PIT (3-for-4, 2 HR, 5 RBIs)
Mariners: Cal RaleighAug. 24 vs. PHI (3-for-4, 3 HR, 4 RBIs)

Raleigh might have struggled to live up to the lofty heights of his 60-homer season in 2025, but we saw his epic power in this game. Raleigh slugged three home runs against the Phillies, which was remarkably the first time in his career that he homered three times in a single game.
Honorable mention: Bryan Woo, Sept. 6 vs. ATH (8 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 9 K)
Rangers: Brandon NimmoApril 11 at LAD (3-for-4, 2B, 2 HR)

Nimmo’s best game in his first season with the Rangers came early in the year against the Dodgers in L.A., as the veteran outfielder recorded three hits and two home runs. It was Nimmo’s only multihomer effort this season, and for good measure, he also doubled.
Honorable mention: Jacob deGrom, Aug. 31 vs. ATH (7 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 8 K)
National League East
Braves: Chris SaleAug. 27 vs. LAD (9 IP, 5 H, 0 R, 11 K)

Sale is an ageless wonder, and the 37-year-old was at his best against the defending World Series champs. He tossed his first shutout since June 5, 2019 -- when he was still with the Red Sox -- and became the first Braves pitcher to throw a shutout since Max Fried on April 23, 2024. The 10-time All-Star also unleashed a 100.1 mph fastball to Shohei Ohtani, cracking triple digits on the radar gun for the first time since 2018.
Honorable mention: Ronald Acuña Jr., May 30 at CIN (2-for-4, 2 HR, 2 SB)
Marlins: Eury PérezSept. 25 vs. ATL (9 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 8 K)

Pérez waded into new territory for his first career complete game, a one-hit shutout against the NL East champion Braves. He had never pitched into the eighth inning in any of his previous 67 career starts before firing a career-high 105 pitches. Pérez, just 23 years old, became the seventh Marlins pitcher to toss a one-hit shutout and the first since Aníbal Sánchez on Sept. 10, 2011.
Honorable mention: Pérez, July 5 at ATH (7 IP, 0 H, 0 R, 8 K)
Mets: Francisco LindorSept. 12 at NYY (3-for-5, 2 HR, 5 RBIs)

Lindor tends to be at his best when the Mets play the Yankees, and that was certainly the case here. The five-time All-Star slugged two home runs -- a leadoff blast off Gerrit Cole and a grand slam -- on the fifth anniversary of his three-homer game against the Yankees, nonetheless. Lindor became just the eighth player in MLB history to hit a leadoff home run and a grand slam in the same game, per the Elias Sports Bureau.
Honorable mention: Bo Bichette, June 12 vs. ATL (2-for-3, 2 HR, 6 RBIs)
Nationals: Andrés ChaparroJuly 17 at ATH (4-for-5, 2 HR, 8 RBIs)

Only one player -- the Pirates’ Ryan O’Hearn -- had more RBIs in a game this season than Chaparro, who tallied a career-high eight RBIs in a 23-4 Nationals romp. Chaparro became the first Nationals player to have at least eight RBIs in a game since Mark Reynolds notched 10 RBIs on July 7, 2018. The 27-year-old, who also belted two home runs, went into the night with just one home run and seven RBIs through his first 31 games of 2026.
Honorable mention: Cade Cavalli, Aug. 13 vs. CHC (8 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 10 K)
Phillies: Bryce HarperJune 20 vs. NYM (4-for-5, 2B, 3B, HR, 3 RBIs)

Is it possible to overshadow a three-homer game? That’s what Harper did to his Phillies teammate, Kyle Schwarber, in a 15-3 rout of the Mets. Harper became the 10th Phillies player to hit for the cycle when he barreled into third base on an eighth-inning triple. The two-time MVP showed plenty of emotion as he completed the feat, and for good reason -- not only are cycles incredibly rare, but Harper entered the game mired in a 1-for-22 slump over his past seven games.
Honorable mention: Jesús Luzardo, Sept. 7 vs. ATL (9 IP, 2 H, 0 R, 12 K)
NL Central
Brewers: Jacob MisiorowskiJune 12 vs. PHI (9 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 15 K)

Misiorowski turned in not only one of the best pitching performances of the season but one of the best in recent memory. The NL Cy Young Award winner gave up just one hit -- a Kyle Schwarber leadoff single in the fourth inning -- and induced a double play to end up facing the minimum 27 batters. Most impressively, Misiorowski racked up 15 strikeouts, the most by any pitcher in a game in 2026, on just 95 pitches.
Honorable mention: Cooper Pratt, World Series Game 4 at TB (4-for-5, 2B, HR)
Cardinals: Joshua BáezAug. 15 at CHC (3-for-4, 3 HR, 5 RBIs)

No player had homered three times in their Major League debut before Báez, who did it in his first three career AT-BATS, a remarkable achievement for the young St. Louis outfielder. Báez ripped a 449-foot two-run dinger in the first inning, slugged a solo shot in the fourth and added another two-run homer in the sixth.
Honorable mention: Alec Burleson, Aug. 3 at NYY (3-for-5, 3 HR, 6 RBIs)
Cubs: Dansby SwansonJuly 1 vs. SD (3-for-5, 3 HR, 8 RBIs)

Swanson had quite the series against the Mets in late June at Citi Field, driving in 15 runs in three games, and he carried that production into a home set with the Padres. After two homers and three RBIs on June 30, Swanson launched three dingers the next day -- a solo shot, a three-run homer and then a grand slam -- in a 23-3 Cubs rout.
Honorable mention: Pete Crow-Armstrong, June 15 vs. COL (4-for-4, 2B, 3B, HR)
Pirates: Ryan O'HearnJuly 7 vs. ATL (4-for-5, 3 HR, 10 RBIs)

A first-inning grand slam kickstarted a historic game for O’Hearn, whose 10 RBIs were the most in a game in franchise history and the most in MLB since Shohei Ohtani in 2024. O’Hearn slugged a pair of three-run homers to reach double-digit RBIs, then added a single for his fourth hit of the day.
Honorable mention: Paul Skenes, May 12 vs. COL (8 IP, 2 H, 0 R, 10 K)
Reds: JJ BledayAug. 22 at AZ (4-for-6, 2B, 3B, HR, 3 RBIs)

Bleday led off the sixth inning at Chase Field with a home run, giving him his first career cycle and the fourth and final cycle across MLB in 2026. Picked up from the Athletics after being non-tendered, he achieved the feat for Cincinnati in just four at-bats, hitting a double, a triple and a single before his solo dinger.
Honorable mention: Hunter Greene, July 10 vs. CHC (7 IP, 3 H, 0 R, 12 K)
NL West
D-backs: Jose FernandezMarch 31 vs. DET (3-for-4, 2 HR, 4 RBIs)

There have only been nine cases of players homering multiple times in their regular-season debut and, remarkably, three of them came in 2026. The players to achieve the feat were the Cardinals’ Joshua Báez (3 HR), the Guardians’ Chase DeLauter and Fernandez. Fernandez homered twice and had three hits against the Tigers, including the game-winning three-run homer in the eighth.
Honorable mention: Ildemaro Vargas, April 26 vs. SD (3-for-5, 2B, 3B, HR, 4 RBIs)
Dodgers: Andy PagesMay 6 at HOU (3-for-5, 3 HR, 6 RBIs)

Pages’ career-best season was exemplified in this performance against the Astros, as he recorded the first three-homer game of his career and drove in six runs. Pages and Max Muncy were the only Dodgers to hit three home runs in a game in 2026.
Honorable mention: Muncy, April 10 vs. TEX (4-for-5, 3 HR, 3 RBIs)
Giants: Heliot RamosJuly 6 vs. TOR (3-for-5, 3B, 2 HR, 5 RBIs)
Ramos was traded to the Yankees a month later, but he had one final monster performance in store for the Giants. Ramos had two homers, a triple and five RBIs against the Blue Jays.
Honorable mention: Matt Chapman, June 5 at CHC (2-for-3, 2 HR, 8 RBIs)
Padres: Jackson MerrillSept. 9 vs. WSH (4-for-5, 3B, 2 HR, 6 RBIs)

Merrill’s season might have started slowly, but he sure turned his fortunes around as the year progressed. In a torrid second half that saw many notable performances, it was this one against the Nationals that stood out, as he recorded four hits, homered twice and drove in six runs.
Honorable mention: Michael King, NL WC G1 vs. CHC (7 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 8 K)
Rockies: Hunter GoodmanJune 14 at ATH (5-for-6, 2B, 2 HR, 4 RBIs)

It was a breakout season for the Rockies catcher, as he crushed 41 home runs and was one of eight players with a 40-homer season. His best performance came in a rout of the A’s in Las Vegas, when Goodman homered twice and set a career high with five hits.
Honorable mention: Goodman, July 19 vs. CIN (3-for-4, 3 HR, 3 RBIs)
items.titleZh: 2026赛季各队最佳单场表现盘点
items.summaryZh: 回顾2026年大联盟各支球队在常规赛与季后赛中的最佳单场个人表现。
bodyZh: 单场10分打点？大联盟生涯首秀轰出三支本垒打？单场15次三振且只被敲出一支安打的完封？
所有这些单场壮举都发生在2026年。这是一个令人难忘的赛季，大联盟打者们总共联手打出了4次完全打击和16场单场三轰的比赛，而大联盟投手则总共奉献了29场单场送出12次以上三振的比赛。
这些只是另一个精彩纷呈的棒球赛季中脱颖而出的部分高光表现。以下是2026年各队最佳个人单场表现的回顾，同时为每个俱乐部列出了一项荣誉提名。
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区
多伦多蓝鸟：Dylan Cease 7月8日客场对阵旧金山巨人（8局，1安打，0失分，11次三振）

Dave Stieb是多伦多蓝鸟队史唯一投过无安打比赛的投手，但在旧金山的一个周三下午，Cease差点复制这一神迹。尽管Cease用了115球才在前八局让巨人队安打挂零，但他无论如何还是跃出牛棚走上第九局的投手丘。这一努力未能持续太久，Heliot Ramos将一颗1好1坏的速球敲中中外野，粉碎了Cease创造历史的企图。不过，在Stieb投出无安打比赛时尚未出生的Cease，依然交出了身披蓝鸟战袍的最佳投球表现之一（值得一提的是，荣誉提名同样属于这一类别）。
荣誉提名：Dylan Cease，7月25日客场对阵波士顿红袜（9局，1安打，0失分，12次三振）
巴尔的摩金莺：Gunnar Henderson 8月30日客场对阵运动家（4打数4安打，2本垒打，5打点）
对Henderson来说这或许是个低迷的赛季，但这位天赋异禀的游击手在这一天对阵运动家时将自己的全部才华展露无遗。凭借两支本垒打和一个三垒安打，Henderson此役得到12个垒打数，这也是自Ryan Mountcastle在2021年6月19日创下13个垒打数以来金莺球员的单场新高。Henderson还在游击防区完成3次精彩守备，帮助金莺赢下比赛。
荣誉提名：Pete Alonso，8月9日客场对阵得克萨斯游骑兵（3打数3安打，2本垒打，4打点，2次保送）
坦帕湾光芒：Drew Rasmussen 美联分区赛对阵纽约洋基第一场（8局，1安打，0失分，10次三振）

Rasmussen用光芒队史最伟大的投球表演之一开启了球队激动人心的十月征程，他在一场以1-0险胜的比赛中用一安打投球压制洋基八局。他成为了季后赛历史上第七位将无安打比赛保持至少7又2/3局的投手，也是自2019年国联冠军赛第一场Aníbal Sánchez以来的第一人。Rasmussen的10次三振追平了光芒投手在季后赛单场比赛中的最多三振纪录，比肩Tyler Glasnow在2020年美联分区赛第二场的表现。
荣誉提名：Junior Caminero，6月25日主场对阵堪萨斯城皇家（5打数3安打，3本垒打，6打点）
波士顿红袜：Ranger Suarez 4月27日客场对阵多伦多蓝鸟（8局，1安打，0失分，10次三振）
Suarez没有浪费太多时间来证明为什么红袜会在上个休赛期与他签下一份五年1.3亿美元的合同。在他代表波士顿的第六次先发中，这位沉稳的左投面对卫冕美联冠军投出八局无失分，送出10次三振。直到Jesús Sánchez在第六局首打席将一颗安打偷袭进三垒垒包内之前，Suarez没有让任何打者上垒。
荣誉提名：Payton Tolle，8月7日主场对阵运动家（6局，2安打，1失分，14次三振）
纽约洋基：Cam Schlittler 美联外卡赛对阵波士顿红袜第一场（6又1/3局，2安打，0失分，10次三振）
在洋基悠久历史中投手打出的最佳赛季之一里，Schlittler再次将他最好的状态留到了季后赛，尤其是面对红袜。这位美联赛扬奖得主在美联外卡赛首战中用一场10次三振的精彩投球压制了波士顿，全场耗费生涯新高的117球，像他一年前在季后赛首秀中一样点燃了布朗克斯。Schlittler比肩传奇人物Bob Gibson，成为了仅有的在季后赛对阵红袜时两度投出单场10次三振的投手。
荣誉提名：Ben Rice，美联外卡赛对阵波士顿红袜第一场（5打数4安打，2本垒打，6打点）
美国联盟中区
克利夫兰守护者：Gavin Williams 9月1日主场对阵多伦多蓝鸟（7局，2安打，0自责分，13次三振）
凭借在进步者球场9月开局战胜蓝鸟这样的表现，Williams以248次三振领跑2026赛季美联。他直到第四局才被敲出安打，一路轻取七局且只丢掉一分非自责分，最终以13次三振收场，这也是守护者先发投手自Triston McKenzie在2022年以来的单场最多三振纪录。
荣誉提名：Travis Bazzana，6月20日客场对阵休斯敦太空人（4打数4安打，2本垒打，5打点）
堪萨斯城皇家：Noah Cameron 8月16日客场对阵洛杉矶天使（9局，1安打，0失分，8次三振）
Cameron在2025赛季为皇家表现出色，在24次先发中交出2.99自责分率并获得美联新人王投票第四名。他在2026赛季初遭遇挣扎，但在下半赛季状态火热强势收官，其中包括八月中旬在客场对天使投出的一安打完封。这位左投全场唯一允许的安打是第七局的一支安打，他也拿下了自Zack Greinke在2009年以来皇家队的第一场一安打完封胜。
荣誉提名：Jac Caglianone，8月8日主场对阵芝加哥小熊（4打数4安打，2支二垒安打，2本垒打，4打点）
底特律老虎：Colt Keith 6月15日客场对阵休斯敦太空人（4打数3安打，3本垒打，6打点）
Keith在2026年唯一的一场单场双响炮表现可谓极其惊艳：他在以9-3大胜太空人的比赛中轰出三发本垒打。在他第一次上场时遭遇满垒触身球后，Keith在第三局击出一支两分炮，第七局再轰一支两分炮，第九局又敲出一发阳春炮。他全场贡献6分打点，将他此前在2024年创造的生涯单场打点纪录提高了2分。
荣誉提名：Casey Mize，6月29日客场对阵纽约洋基（7局，1安打，0失分，10次三振）
明尼苏达双城：Bailey Ober 5月12日主场对阵迈阿密马林鱼（9局，2安打，0失分，7次三振）
Ober投出了双城自2023年7月Pablo López以来的首场完封胜，在标靶球场压制马林鱼。他在第二局被敲出一支短打安打，第四局又丢了一支安打，但这就是马林鱼从这位身高6尺9寸的右投手中仅能得到的全部结果，他送出7次三振且没有投出任何保送。
荣誉提名：Byron Buxton，4月14日主场对阵波士顿红袜（5打数4安打，2本垒打）
芝加哥白袜：Tristan Peters 7月10日主场对阵运动家（4打数4安打，1支二垒安打，1支三垒安打，1本垒打，4打点）

items.titleEn: Here's how Chisholm can find the sweet spot in Toronto
bodyEn: TORONTO -- If this works, the Blue Jays could uncover another version of Marcus Semien’s sensational one-and-done season in 2021. If it doesn’t, at least it will be entertaining.

The Blue Jays agreed to terms on a one-year, $20 million deal with former Yankees infielder Jazz Chisholm Jr. on Friday, including a complex option structure for 2028. This is a short-term move with serious upside for both sides, and in Chisholm, the Blue Jays aren’t just betting on raw talent. He’s done this before.

In 2025 with the Yankees, Chisholm launched 31 home runs and stole 31 bases, the second season of his career with an OPS north of .800. He was worth 4.3 WAR (FanGraphs) that season, pairing those big, obvious numbers with some great metrics on the bases and defensively.

The Blue Jays need to find that version of Chisholm again, and the 28-year-old will have every reason in the world to do it, given the potential of another trip to free agency just a year from now. These are the questions they’ll face:
1. How do they unlock the ceiling of Chisholm’s offensive upside?
It’s all about the fastball.

There were no dramatic spikes in strikeout rates or red flags with Chisholm’s swing decisions, but his production against fastballs from 2025 to '26 jumps right off the page. Once we get to Spring Training, that needs to be one of the biggest areas of focus and will be a big assignment for hitting coach David Popkins and his staff.
Chisholm vs. fastballs• 2025: .486 SLG%, +1 Run Value• 2026: .331 SLG%, -10 Run Value

Chisholm’s average bat speed did drop just a bit from 2025 to '26 (1 mph), and he didn’t max out his hardest swing nearly as often, but entering his age-29 season, this shouldn’t be an issue of “decline.” With a fresh start, a fresh training staff and fresh eyes, this feels like a major bounce-back opportunity for Chisholm.

Let’s go back one more season. How would you feel about getting his 2024 season, split between Miami and New York, with 24 home runs, 40 stolen bases and a .760 OPS? Blue Jays manager John Schneider would surely say “sign me up” ... and there might be some other words mixed in there, too.

The Blue Jays have plenty of “good” runners, but they’ve lacked high-end baserunning threats for too long, which is why that’s been an extreme priority this offseason. Sure, some of Chisholm’s errors on the bases or in the field can be tough, but the metrics love him. Over the past three seasons, he’s been worth +12 Run Value on the bases, 16th among all MLB players.
2. What’s the sweet spot, defensively?
The domino effect here is crucial, and don’t forget the DH spot.

After George Springer was the primary DH, the Blue Jays want to break from that. Chisholm will take plenty of reps from Ernie Clement at second base, but this shouldn’t be framed as a demotion for Clement. He can play every spot on the infield and play them well, which means … a DH day for Vladimir Guerrero Jr., a DH day for Kazuma Okamoto, even the odd DH day for Chisholm. It still feels like that somehow, some way, Clement is a near-everyday player.

The fancy stats paint Chisholm’s 2026 season as his best defensive performance yet, worth a +8 Run Value. Expect plenty of second and third base, but Chisholm made 95 starts in center field in 2024. Pair that with Clement’s versatility? Schneider’s got options.
3. What about that big personality we keep hearing about?

There have been ejections, some fiery and some spilling on to social media. There’s been everything from beef with opponents to a time last June when Chisholm played second base with a lollipop in his mouth.

How much of this is a problem, and how much is just a big personality? Sometimes it just depends on whether he’s playing well at the time. Let’s not overstate any of it, though, and after the Blue Jays grew stale by the midway point of the 2026 season, a little swagger sounds like a great idea.

Remember those 2015-16 teams, led by José Bautista, Josh Donaldson, Russell Martin and a dozen others who spilled over with attitude? John Gibbons called them “a bunch of renegades,” and that’s exactly why Canadian baseball fans loved them. They’d beat you, then let you hear about it.

This could be a welcome change, shaking up a clubhouse in the right way. Schneider should be a good fit with Chisholm, too, a manager who’s firm with players behind the scenes, but has learned how to tame some lions and work well with all personalities.
items.titleZh: Jazz Chisholm Jr.如何能在多伦多找到最佳状态
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟与前洋基内野手Jazz Chisholm Jr.达成一年2000万美元合同，双方均面临机遇与挑战。
bodyZh: 多伦多报道——如果这笔签约奏效，多伦多蓝鸟可能会发掘出类似于Marcus Semien在2021年轰动一时的单赛季高光表现。如果未能奏效，至少过程会充满娱乐性。
蓝鸟在周五与前纽约洋基内野手Jazz Chisholm Jr.达成了一份为期一年、价值2000万美元的协议，其中包括针对2028年的复杂选项结构。这是一笔对双方而言都具有巨大上限的短期运作，对于Chisholm，蓝鸟不仅是在押注其纯粹的天赋。他曾经做到过这一点。
在2025年效力洋基期间，Chisholm轰出了31记本垒打并盗垒31次，这是他职业生涯中第二个OPS超过.800的赛季。他在那个赛季的WAR值达到4.3（FanGraphs数据），将这些亮眼且直观的数据与在垒上以及防守端的优秀高阶指标完美结合。
蓝鸟需要找回那个版本的Chisholm，考虑到一年后再次成为自由球员的潜力，这位28岁的球员将有充分的理由去实现这一点。以下是他们将面临的问题：
1. 他们如何释放Chisholm进攻上限的潜力？
关键全在于直球。
Chisholm的三振率没有出现戏剧性的飙升，他的挥棒决策也没有亮起红灯，但从2025年到2026年，他对阵直球的产出出现了断崖式下跌。一旦进入春训，这必须成为重点关注的领域之一，也将是打击教练David Popkins及其团队的一项重大任务。
Chisholm对阵直球数据 • 2025年：长打率.486，得分价值+1 • 2026年：长打率.331，得分价值-10
Chisholm的平均挥棒速度从2025年到2026年确实略有下降（1英里/小时），而且他达到最快挥棒极值的频率也没有那么高了，但在进入29岁赛季之际，这不应该被视为“状态下滑”的问题。随着一个新的开始、全新的训练团队和全新的视角，这感觉像是Chisholm迎来重大反弹的好机会。
让我们再回顾一个赛季。如果你能得到他在迈阿密和纽约两地分属的2024赛季表现——24记本垒打、40次盗垒以及.760的OPS，你觉得怎么样？蓝鸟总教练John Schneider肯定会说“算我一个”……而且其中可能还会夹杂一些别的话。
蓝鸟拥有许多“不错”的跑垒员，但他们长期缺乏高水平的跑垒威胁，这就是为什么这成为今年休赛期极其重要的事情。当然，Chisholm在垒上或防守端的一些失误可能会让人头疼，但高阶数据非常青睐他。在过去三个赛季中，他在垒上的得分价值达到了+12，在所有大联盟球员中排名第16位。
2. 防守上的最佳甜蜜点在哪里？
这里的骨牌效应至关重要，而且不要忘记指定打击的位置。

在George Springer担任主力指定打击之后，蓝鸟希望打破这种模式。Chisholm将会分担Ernie Clement在二垒的大量守备局数，但这不应该被解读为对Clement的降职。他可以守内野的每一个位置并且表现出色，这意味着……Vladimir Guerrero Jr.可以有一天担任指定打击，Kazuma Okamoto可以有一天担任指定打击，甚至Chisholm也可以偶尔担任指定打击。不管怎样，Clement感觉依然会是一名接近全勤的球员。
高阶数据将Chisholm的2026赛季描绘为他迄今为止防守表现最好的一年，得分价值达到+8。预计他会大量镇守二垒和三垒，但Chisholm在2024年曾有过95场先发中外野手的经历。将其与Clement的多面手属性结合起来？Schneider拥有诸多选择。
3. 我们经常听说的那个大牌性格怎么办？
曾经有过被驱逐出场的情况，有些火药味十足，有些则蔓延到了社交媒体上。从与对手的争执，到去年6月Chisholm嘴里含着棒棒糖防守二垒，各种情况应有尽有。
这其中有多少是问题，又有多少只是张扬的个性？有时这完全取决于他当时比赛打得好不好。不过，我们也不必过分夸大这一切，在蓝鸟在2026赛季中段显得暮气沉沉之后，带点傲气听起来是个极好的主意。
还记得2015-16赛季的那支球队吗？以José Bautista、Josh Donaldson、Russell Martin以及其他十几位充满个性的球员为首。John Gibbons称他们为“一群叛逆者”，这正是加拿大棒球球迷喜爱他们的原因。他们击败你，然后还要让你听到他们的声音。
这可能是一个受欢迎的改变，以正确的方式重塑更衣室。Schneider与Chisholm应该也会很契合，他是一位在幕后对球员要求严格，但已经学会如何驯服雄狮并与各种性格相处融洽的总教练。

items.titleEn: Jazz, Blue Jays agree to one-year deal with player option for '28 (source)
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have agreed to terms on a one-year, $20 million deal with Jazz Chisholm Jr. that includes a player option for 2028, a source confirmed to MLB.com, another major swing on upside just hours after officially announcing their five-year, $80 million deal with Japanese right-hander Kaima Taira.
The club has not confirmed the contract.
The structure of this deal is complex, but crucial.

The $20 million number is built off a 2027 base salary of $12.5 million with a $6 million bonus. It also includes a $1.5 million buyout on the 2028 option, guaranteeing an even $20 million off the top. Chisholm’s player option is for $16 million in ’28, but if he declines that option, it then triggers to become a club option worth $40 million. If that plays out, Chisholm would earn $58.5 million over the two seasons.

Chisholm is coming off a down year with the Yankees, but is still just 28 years old and loaded with talent. He brings not only the power upside the Blue Jays need, but also the baserunning potential that they crave this offseason. He also grades out as a strong defender, fitting in well with one of the Blue Jays’ existing strengths.

This should immediately bring back some fond memories of Marcus Semien, too. In 2021, Semien’s free agency was poorly timed when he hit the market coming off a down year with the A’s, but he signed a one-year deal in Toronto and put up a career season, launching 45 home runs with an .873 OPS in one of the most potent offenses we’ve ever seen in Toronto. That’s an awfully high bar, but Chisholm has all the talent he needs and motivation shouldn’t be an issue here, with another shot at free agency as early as 2027-28.
Here's how Chisholm can find the sweet spot in Toronto

Last season in New York, Chisholm hit .231 with 19 home runs and a .711 OPS, but he did steal 41 bases along the way. He’s primarily a second baseman at this point but plays some third and has plenty of experience in the outfield, giving manager John Schneider some options.

This has a direct impact on Ernie Clement, the beloved second baseman who started out the 2026 season hot but faded down the stretch. This shouldn’t be framed as a demotion or step down for Clement, though, given his potential to play multiple positions as one of the best athletes on this roster. Clement can handle all four infield positions, and while he hasn’t played much outfield professionally, everything will be on the table. Chisholm has always hit right-handed pitching much better than lefties, too, so matchups will play into this.

This addition immediately shifts the Blue Jays’ infield depth into a much stronger spot, but their outfield is still open for business. The Blue Jays were baseball’s lowest-scoring offense a year ago, a complete power outage after their spectacular run to Game 7 of the World Series in 2025 against the Dodgers. If there’s anywhere to make one more big addition -- and they still need it -- it’s in the outfield.

Seiya Suzuki remains a very clean fit with the Blue Jays, representing many parallels to how well George Springer fit this team six years ago, and Randy Arozarena is still available. If the season started tomorrow, the Blue Jays would likely have Brett Bateman in center field with Nathan Lukes in one corner and potentially Anthony Santander in another, assuming Addison Barger (right elbow surgery) isn’t ready by then.

Chisholm represents potential, though, and that’s a fine start. He’ll also bring some swagger to a roster that might benefit from it after such a flat 2026 season. Chisholm’s personality didn’t always land well with Yankees fans, especially when his numbers dipped, but one of Schneider’s strengths is his ability to work with players on an individual level. That should be a strong relationship, and if Chisholm hits the ground running in Toronto, it’s easy to envision him capturing lighting in a bottle here as a fan favorite.

The Blue Jays remain heavily involved in the free-agent market, including the top tier of relievers. This coming Monday, the club will introduce Taira with a news conference at Rogers Centre, at which time we should learn more about Chisholm’s role in 2027 and potentially beyond.
items.titleZh: 消息称多伦多蓝鸟与 Jazz 达成一年合同，含 2028 年球员选项
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟与 Jazz Chisholm Jr. 达成一项价值 2000 万美元的一年期合同，包含 2028 年球员选项。
bodyZh: 多伦多消息 —— 据消息人士向 MLB.com 确认，多伦多蓝鸟已与 Jazz Chisholm Jr. 就一份为期一年、价值 2000 万美元的合同达成一致，其中包含 2028 年的球员选项。就在官方宣布与日本右投手 Kaima Taira 签下五年 8000 万美元合同的几个小时后，蓝鸟再次对潜力上限进行了重大押注。
俱乐部尚未证实这份合同。
这笔交易的结构很复杂，但至关重要。
2000 万美元的数字是由 2027 年 1250 万美元的基本薪资加上 600 万美元奖金构成的。它还包括对 2028 年选项的 150 万美元买断费，直接确保总额达到整整 2000 万美元。Chisholm 的球员选项在 2028 年价值 1600 万美元，但如果他拒绝该选项，则会触发价值 4000 万美元的球队选项。如果按这样发展，Chisholm 在这两个赛季中将获得 5850 万美元。
Chisholm 在纽约洋基经历了一个低迷的赛季，但他今年才 28 岁，天赋满满。他不仅带来了多伦多蓝鸟队所需的本垒打潜力，还带来了球队在今年休赛期极度渴望的跑垒潜力。他的防守评级也很高，与多伦多蓝鸟现有的优势之一完美契合。

这也应该会立刻让人想起关于 Marcus Semien 的美好回忆。在 2021 年，Semien 在离开运动家时正处于低迷赛季，他的自由球员市场时机并不好，但他在多伦多签下了一年合同并打出了职业生涯的巅峰赛季，在多伦多我们见过的最具火力的进攻阵容之一中轰出了 45 场本垒打，攻击指数达到 .873。这是一个极高的标准，但 Chisholm 具备了他需要的所有天赋，而且随着最早在 2027-28 年再次获得成为自由球员的机会，动力对这里来说绝对不是问题。
以下是 Chisholm 如何在多伦多找到甜点区的方法
上个赛季在纽约，Chisholm 的打击率为 .231，有 19 个本垒打和 .711 的攻击指数，但他同时也盗了 41 个垒。他目前主要是一名二垒手，但也打过三垒，并且在三外野有丰富的经验，这为主教练 John Schneider 提供了一些选择。
这直接影响到了 Ernie Clement，这位深受喜爱的二垒手在 2026 赛季开局火热，但在赛季末期有所下滑。鉴于 Clement 作为球队最佳运动员之一可以胜任多个位置的潜力，这不应被视为对他的降职或退步。Clement 可以胜任内野全部四个位置，虽然他在职业生涯中没有打过太多外野，但一切皆有可能。Chisholm 面对右投手的打击表现一直比左投手好得多，因此对阵安排也会发挥作用。
这一引援立即将多伦多蓝鸟的内野深度提升到了一个更加强劲的位置，但他们的外野依然敞开大门。多伦多蓝鸟在一年前是全联盟得分最低的进攻球队，在 2025 年与洛杉矶道奇惊心动魄地打到世界大赛第七场之后，他们的进攻火力完全熄灭。如果要说还有哪里需要做出一笔重大补强——而且他们确实还需要——那就是外野。

Seiya Suzuki 与多伦多蓝鸟非常契合，这与六年前 George Springer 对这支球队的契合度有许多相似之处，并且 Randy Arozarena 仍然处于可签状态。如果明天就开赛，多伦多蓝鸟可能会让 Brett Bateman 镇守中外野，Nathan Lukes 镇守一个角落，而 Anthony Santander 镇守另一个角落（假设 Addison Barger 的右肘手术届时尚未完全康复）。

不过，Chisholm 代表着潜力，这是一个很好的开始。在经历了如此平淡的 2026 赛季后，他也将为可能会受益的阵容带来一些自信与傲气。Chisholm 的性格并不总是能很好地被洋基球迷接受，尤其是当他的数据下滑时，但 Schneider 的强项之一就是他能够与球员进行个体层面的合作。这应该会建立起牢固的关系，如果 Chisholm 在多伦多迅速进入状态，我们不难想象他能在这里大放异彩并成为球迷的最爱。
多伦多蓝鸟仍然深度参与自由球员市场，包括顶级后援投手。本周一，俱乐部将在罗杰斯中心举行新闻发布会介绍 Taira，届时我们应该会进一步了解 Chisholm 在 2027 赛季及之后的角色。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays bring in Japanese ERA leader Taira on five-year deal
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have made their first big splash of the offseason, agreeing to terms on a five-year, $80 million deal with Japanese right-hander Kaima Taira, a source told MLB.com. The deal includes an opt-out after the third season.
The club has not yet announced the deal or when Taira will be introduced.

Taira’s signing comes amid a flurry of movement on the free-agent pitching market Tuesday, including Freddy Peralta agreeing to a five-year, $125 million deal with the Orioles and Trevor Rogers agreeing to a five-year, $120 million deal with the Cubs.

Taira is one of the most unique pitchers on the market, standing just 5-foot-8 but with tremendous upside. There aren’t many recent comps for Taira in Major League Baseball, but the Blue Jays are making an aggressive bet on his tantalizing talent coming over from Japan.

The 27-year-old has pitched professionally with the Saitama Seibu Lions and is coming off a career year in the rotation, posting a 1.36 ERA -- the best mark in Nippon Professional Baseball -- over 146 innings. His fastball is the headliner, coming from such a unique release point and touching 99 mph, but Taira also has an incredibly deep mix of pitches. From Chris Bassitt to Dylan Cease, the Blue Jays have a long line of starters who love to tinker with an expanded arsenal, but Taira takes it to another level.

In Toronto, Taira will quickly draw comparisons to Marcus Stroman, who stood just 5-foot-7 and pitched for the Blue Jays from 2014-19. They’re drastically different pitchers, though, as Stroman relied on weak contact and extreme ground-ball rates while Taira has more swing-and-miss potential.

Taira came up as a reliever in Japan, and after moving into the rotation in 2023 (150 innings), he pivoted back to the bullpen following some arm issues. Taira is being paid as a starter and will pitch as a starter for the Blue Jays, but you won’t be seeing him chase down 120 pitches each start like Cease.

What’s allowed Taira to succeed in these roles is his explosiveness on the mound and a very unique delivery. Like many Japanese pitchers, Taira makes excellent use of his lower body to drive down the mound, but he also has a rare level extension for his size. Taira releases the baseball 6.8 feet in front of the rubber, further down the mound than MLB average (6.5 feet). This means that Taira essentially makes up for his lack of height, releasing the ball further down the mound than many classic, 6-foot-3 pitchers may.

Taira’s addition immediately shifts the Blue Jays’ rotation into focus, and while more depth will still be needed, this organization can now feel very confident in its starting five. Behind Cease, the Blue Jays now boast Taira, Trey Yesavage and José Soriano, who the Blue Jays have high expectations for after acquiring him at the 2026 Trade Deadline. Cody Ponce lines up as the No. 5 starter with Spencer Miles offering another option, capable of pitching in a variety of roles.
By no means are the Blue Jays done. Fresh off a 79-83 season, finishing last in the AL East, this needs to be the beginning of something much larger.

The Blue Jays are shopping at the top end of the relief market still, but their most glaring need is in the lineup. The Blue Jays were Major League Baseball’s lowest-scoring offense a year ago, and while Vladimir Guerrero Jr.’s power outage was the leading culprit, this entire lineup needs a makeover. Seiya Suzuki remains a clear and obvious fit, which would give the Blue Jays three Japanese stars alongside Taira and Kazuma Okamoto.

The Blue Jays have consciously targeted the Japanese market, not only for its talent, but for the many business opportunities which come along with it. The signing of Okamoto one year ago gave the Blue Jays a taste of that market’s appetite, but club president and CEO Mark Shapiro along with general manager Ross Atkins have always believed it would take multiple years to appreciate the true impact. Now, with Taira, the Blue Jays have another significant piece of that market and can continue to grow their reputation as a true destination for Japanese stars.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟以五年合同签下日本自责分率王平良海马
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟签下日本右投平良海马，双方达成五年8000万美元合同。
bodyZh: 多伦多——据消息人士向MLB.com透露，多伦多蓝鸟完成了他们休赛期的第一笔大动作，与日本右投平良海马（Kaima Taira）就一份为期五年、价值8000万美元的合同达成一致。该合同包含在第三个赛季结束后的跳出选项。
球团尚未正式宣布这笔签约，也未公布平良海马的加盟见面会时间。
平良海马的签约正值周二自由球员投手市场活跃之际，其中包括Freddy Peralta与巴尔地摩金莺达成五年1.25亿美元合同，以及Trevor Rogers与芝加哥小熊达成五年1.20亿美元合同。
平良海马是市场上最独特的投手之一，身高仅有5尺8寸，但拥有巨大的上限。在大联盟中，近几年很难找到平良海马的直接对标人选，但多伦多蓝鸟正对这位从日本登陆的天赋异禀的投手进行激进的押注。
这位27岁的投手此前效力于日本职业棒球埼玉西武狮，在先发轮值中度过了生涯巅峰的一年，在146局的投球中交出1.36的自责分率，这也是日本职业棒球的最佳战绩。他的直球是招牌武器，投球出手点非常独特且球速可达99英里/小时，同时平良海马还拥有极其丰富的球种组合。从Chris Bassitt到Dylan Cease，多伦多蓝鸟拥有许多喜欢打磨丰富球路的先发投手，但平良海马将这一点提升到了全新的高度。
在多伦多，平良海马很快会被拿来与Marcus Stroman进行比较，后者身高仅5尺7寸，曾在2014至2019年效力于多伦多蓝鸟。不过，他们是风格截然不同的投手，Stroman依赖制造软弱击球和极高的滚地球率，而平良海马则具备更多三振对手的潜力。
平良海马在日本是以牛棚投手身份崭露头角的，在2023年转型担任先发投手（投了150局）并在经历一些手臂伤情后，他又重回牛棚。平良海马是以先发投手的薪资加盟，也将作为多伦多蓝鸟的先发投手出战，但你不会看到他像Cease那样每场比赛去拼120个投球数。
让平良海马在这些角色中取得成功的是他在投手丘上的爆发力和非常独特的投球动作。和许多日本投手一样，平良海马充分利用下半身向投手丘前施压，同时以他的身材而言，他还拥有罕见的延伸度。平良海马在距离投手板前方6.8英尺处出手投球，比大联盟平均水平（6.5英尺）更靠前。这意味着平良海马在很大程度上弥补了身高的不足，其出手点比许多传统的6尺3寸投手还要靠前。
平良海马的加入立即让多伦多蓝鸟的先发轮值成为焦点，尽管仍需补充更多深度，但该球团现在对他们的前五号先发充满信心。在Cease之后，多伦多蓝鸟现在拥有平良海马、Trey Yesavage以及José Soriano，蓝鸟在2026年交易截止日引进后者后对他寄予厚望。Cody Ponce排在五号先发位置，Spencer Miles则提供了另一种选择，能够胜任多种角色。
多伦多蓝鸟绝没有就此罢休。在刚刚经历了一个79胜83败、排名美联东区垫底的赛季后，这必须是更大动作的开始。
多伦多蓝鸟仍在后援投手市场的高端物色人选，但他们最显眼的需求还是在打线。一年前，多伦多蓝鸟是大联盟得分最少的球队，虽然Vladimir Guerrero Jr.的长打能力下滑是主要原因，但整条打线都需要重组。铃木诚也（Seiya Suzuki）依然是一个清晰且明显的人选，如果加盟，他将与平良海马和冈本和真（Kazuma Okamoto）一起为多伦多蓝鸟带来三位日本球星。
多伦多蓝鸟一直有意识地瞄准日本市场，不仅是为了其人才，也是为了随之而来的众多商业机会。一年前签下冈本和真让多伦多蓝鸟品尝到了该市场热度的滋味，但球团总裁兼首席执行官Mark Shapiro以及总经理Ross Atkins一直坚信，需要多年的时间才能体会到真正的冲击。如今，随着平良海马的加盟，多伦多蓝鸟在该市场又拥有了一块重要拼图，并可以继续巩固其作为日本球星真正向往之地的声誉。

items.titleEn: The 16 most jaw-dropping Statcast feats of 2026
bodyEn: It's time for our annual Statcast superlatives -- the best of the best plays of 2026.

We've got all the cool numbers behind every type of highlight-reel play from this year, from hitting to pitching to fielding to baserunning. Let's take a look back at the longest home run, the fastest strikeout, the speediest inside-the-parker, the best catch and a whole lot more.
Here are 16 of the top plays that defined the 2026 season.
Hardest-hit ballOneil Cruz -- 119.0 mph double (April 16)

Not even 120 mph for the hardest-hit ball of the year? Maybe Cruz has lost a step. Just kidding, Oneil. We're just spoiled by the missiles he's hit over the past couple of seasons. This is the third straight season the Pirates slugger has had the hardest-hit ball of the year. He had a 121.5 mph double in 2024, a 122.9 mph home run in 2025 and now this.
Hardest home runOneil Cruz -- 117.4 mph (Sept. 10)

Of course it's Cruz again, the king of exit velo. He actually had the two hardest-hit home runs of the year, and even though this one was absolutely hammered, we want to take a second to remember the No. 2 blast -- because that one was the 116.9 mph moonshot Cruz hit off the top of the foul pole in April.
Longest home runLazaro Montes (Sept. 8) / Fernando Tatis Jr. (July 21) -- 474 feet

We've got a tie for the longest home run of 2026. You can be the judge of which one was more impressive -- the rookie Montes going where no one has gone before in Seattle (see the clip up at the top of this story) or the bat-flipping superstar Tatis launching a towering shot in Atlanta.
Fastest pitch hit for a walk-offJackson Chourio (NLDS Game 2) -- 101.3 mph

OK, fine, we created this category just so we could talk about this play one more time. It might've been our favorite moment of the whole season. And it was definitely the single biggest play of the Brewers' entire World Series run: Chourio's walk-off hit off Mason Miller in the National League Division Series. Turning around a 101.3 mph fastball from the game's best closer when you're down to your last strike in a postseason game is definitely worthy of a Statcast superlative. So here it is: Chourio's rip was the fastest pitch hit for a walk-off in the entire pitch-tracking era, which goes back to 2008.
Fastest pitchJacob Misiorowski -- 105.5 mph (June 26)

Of the 1,300 pitches Misiorowski fired in triple digits this year, this one was the very fastest -- and it was in a Cy Young vs. MVP matchup: the Miz vs. Pete Crow-Armstrong. Misiorowski became just the fourth pitcher in the pitch-tracking era to break the 105 mph mark, along with Aroldis Chapman, Ben Joyce and Jordan Hicks. And only Chapman has thrown a faster pitch than the Miz's 105.5.
Fastest strikeoutJacob Misiorowski -- 104.5 mph (June 12 / July 26)

It was the Year of the Miz, so here are a couple more heaters for you to watch, one to blow away Kyle Schwarber, the other to ring up Kyle Karros (we guess Misiorowski has something against Kyles). Misiorowski is the only starting pitcher on record to even throw a pitch 104 mph or faster, let alone record any strikeouts at that velocity.
Slowest pitch (by a real pitcher)Seth Halvorsen -- 32.6 mph (Sept. 19)

We don't really care about position player pitchers throwing lobs (if you're curious, the slowest one was 30.3 mph by James McCann), but we DO enjoy when a real pitcher throws one in the 30s, because it usually means something weird happened. This season, the honor goes to Halvorsen -- normally one of the league's hardest throwers -- who lost his footing on the mound and shot-putted a 32.6 mph eephus to the plate. Very humorously, it turned into the slowest hit-by-pitch ever when Drew Gilbert simply stood in the batter's box and let the bouncing ball "plunk" him in the thigh.
Slowest pitch for a KJose Trevino -- 39.0 mph (Sept. 9)

The one time we do like a position player eephus is when it somehow gets a strikeout. This year, the slowest K was by Trevino against the Dodgers' Alex Freeland, whose bat went flying out of the screen as he hacked and missed at a pitch that didn't even crack the 40 mph mark. Trevino also induced the slowest swing-and-miss of the year two days later with a 31 mph eephus against Christian Yelich. Yelich's swing might have been even slower than the pitch.
Most pitch movement on a swing-and-missBrooks Raley -- 35 inches of horizontal break (April 7)

You can see the wind whipping as Raley spins this sweeper at Citi Field in April, and that wind-swept sweeper broke nearly three feet. No wonder Luken Baker whiffed at it. In the same inning, Raley also struck out Jorge Barrosa with a sweeper that moved 28 inches -- the most horizontal break on a K this year.
Fastest inside-the-park home runBobby Witt Jr. -- 14.13 seconds (May 9)

Only two other players in the Statcast era (since 2015) have circled the bases faster than Witt on this season's inside-the-parker -- Byron Buxton twice (13.85 seconds in 2017 and 14.05 seconds in 2016) and PCA (14.08 seconds in 2024). The Royals star was even speedier here than on his first career inside-the-park home run, which took him 14.29 seconds in 2023.
Slowest home run trotJunior Caminero -- 40.65 seconds (Sept. 15)

This is the kind of Statcast record we like to see set. Caminero became the official king of the slow trot this year with a 40-plus second trip around the bases after this walk-off home run in September. The Rays superstar slugger also took the second-longest home run trot of the Statcast era, 38.66 seconds, on the homer that helped send the Rays to the World Series in Game 6 of the ALCS.
Fastest tripleCorbin Carroll -- 10.82 seconds (Aug. 8)

No one hits triples like Carroll. Not only does the D-backs star hit the most triples -- he's led the league four seasons in a row -- he hits the fastest triples. This season, his best one was a game-tying triple in the bottom of the ninth against the rival Dodgers.
Fastest pop time to second base on a caught stealingBrandon Valenzuela -- 1.72 seconds (June 13)

Valenzuela quickly proved himself to be a defensive star as a rookie with the Blue Jays in 2026, especially with his arm behind the plate. This was a perfect throw to nab Ryan McMahon trying to steal second base -- an average pop time is closer to two seconds, so Valenzuela blew that out of the water.
Hardest outfield assistCarson Benge -- 103.9 mph (Aug. 17)

This might have been the defining game of a sensational rookie season for Benge. The Mets' up-and-coming star threw out two Padres runners at the plate -- in the same inning! The Padres probably should've learned their lesson when his first throw was a 99.9 mph strike to nab Jake Cronenworth. But they didn't … so Benge one-upped himself with a 103.9 mph cannon to nail Manny Machado.
Hardest infielder assistElly De La Cruz -- 102.0 mph (Sept. 9)

You just don't see triple-digit arm strengths from an infielder … unless that infielder's name is "Elly De La Cruz." The Reds star took away an inside-the-park home run from Teoscar Hernández with this rocket relay to the plate -- the first recorded triple-digit assist by an infielder in the Statcast era. De La Cruz now has all of the top five hardest infielder assists since 2015 -- in other words, he broke his own record four times over.
Best catch by catch probabilityPete Crow-Armstrong -- 5% (May 30)

This one's always a little subjective, because a 5% catch is the most difficult grade Statcast assigns, and every season gives us a bunch of candidates at that threshold to choose from. But how could we not choose one by PCA, who just had one of the best defensive seasons we've ever seen?

Here's our favorite 5-percenter from the NL MVP -- a game-ending grab against the rival Cardinals where Crow-Armstrong had to cover 81 feet in just 4.3 seconds to make the sliding play. PCA reached an elite sprint speed of 30.2 feet per second to get to the ball in time, and he got a typically incredible jump (+9.5 feet better than an average outfielder). He always looks so slick with it.
items.titleZh: 2026赛季Statcast最具震撼力的16项数据纪录
items.summaryZh: 盘点2026赛季Statcast追踪系统记录的16项最震撼、最极致的棒球数据与精彩瞬间。
bodyZh: 又到了我们一年一度的Statcast之最评选时间——盘点2026赛季最顶尖的击球、投球、防守与跑垒表现。
我们收集了今年所有精彩集锦背后最酷的数据，涵盖打击、投球、防守到跑垒。让我们一起回顾最远本垒打、最快三振、最快场内本垒打、最佳美技接杀以及更多精彩瞬间。
以下是定义2026赛季的16项顶级表现。
最强劲击球：Oneil Cruz —— 119.0英里/小时二垒安打（4月16日）
年度最强劲击球连120英里/小时都没达到？也许Oneil Cruz状态有所下滑。开玩笑的，Oneil。我们只是被他过去几个赛季轰出的导弹球给惯坏了。这是这位海盗重炮手连续第三个赛季打出年度最强劲击球。他在2024年打出过121.5英里/小时的二垒安打，2025年轰出122.9英里/小时本垒打，而现在又有了这一球。
最强劲本垒打：Oneil Cruz —— 117.4英里/小时（9月10日）
毫无疑问又是Cruz，出球速度之王。实际上他包揽了今年出球速度最快的前两记本垒打，尽管这一球绝对是轰得粉碎，但我们还是想花一秒钟回忆一下排名第二的轰炸——因为那一球是Cruz在4月份击中犯规柱顶端、速度达116.9英里/小时的超远本垒打。
最远本垒打：Lazaro Montes（9月8日） / Fernando Tatis Jr.（7月21日） —— 474英尺
2026赛季的最远本垒打出现了并列。你可以评判哪一个更令人印象深刻——新秀Montes在西雅图打出了前无古人的远射（见本文顶部的视频剪辑），还是自带甩棒庆祝的超级巨星Tatis在亚特兰大轰出的冲天炮。
击出再见安打的最快球速：Jackson Chourio（国联分区赛第二场） —— 101.3英里/小时

好吧，没关系，我们设立这个分类纯粹是为了能再谈谈这个表现。这可能是我们整个赛季最喜欢的时刻。这绝对也是酿酒人整个世界大赛征程中最重磅的一记安打：Chourio在国家联盟分区赛上面对Mason Miller敲出的再见安打。在季后赛逼近好球数耗尽的绝境下，将这位地表最强终结者的101.3英里/小时速球轰成安打，绝对配得上Statcast的至高荣誉。所以它来了：在自2008年开始的球速追踪时代里，Chourio的这一击是所有击出再见安打的球中最快的一球。
最快球速：Jacob Misiorowski —— 105.5英里/小时（6月26日）

在Misiorowski今年投出的1300记上百英里时速的投球中，这一球是绝对最快的一球——而且这是一场赛扬奖与常规赛MVP候选人的直接对话：The Miz对决Pete Crow-Armstrong。Misiorowski成为了球速追踪时代第四位突破105英里/小时大关的投手，此前三人为Aroldis Chapman、Ben Joyce和Jordan Hicks。而且除了Chapman之外，没有人的球速比The Miz的105.5英里/小时更快。
最快三振：Jacob Misiorowski —— 104.5英里/小时（6月12日 / 7月26日）
这是属于The Miz的一年，所以这里还有几记火球供你欣赏，一球三振了Kyle Schwarber，另一球解决掉Kyle Karros（我们猜Misiorowski跟叫Kyle的人有仇）。Misiorowski是有记录以来唯一一位能投出104英里/小时或更快球速的先发投手，更不用说在这个球速下完成三振了。
最慢投球（实战投手）：Seth Halvorsen —— 32.6英里/小时（9月19日）

我们其实不太在乎野手客串投手时抛出的高飞球（如果你好奇的话，最慢的一球是James McCann投出的30.3英里/小时），但我们确实喜欢正规投手投出30英里/小时档位的时候，因为这通常意味着发生了诡异的事情。本赛季，这个荣誉归属于Halvorsen——他平时是联盟中球速最快的投手之一，却在投手丘上脚底打滑，以32.6英里/小时的怪异慢球将球送向本垒。非常滑稽的是，当Drew Gilbert站在打击区里任由弹地球“砸”中大腿时，这演变成了有史以来最慢的触身球。
三振打者的最慢投球：Jose Trevino —— 39.0英里/小时（9月9日）
我们唯一喜欢野手投慢球的情况是它莫名其妙三振了打者。今年，最慢的三振由Trevino送给道奇的Alex Freeland，当时后者面对一块连40英里/小时都不到的投球挥空，连球棒都脱手飞出了网外。两天后，Trevino面对Christian Yelich投出一记31英里/小时的慢球，再次制造了本赛季最慢的挥空。Yelich的挥棒速度可能比那球还要慢。
挥空时最大球路位移：Brooks Raley —— 35英寸水平位移（4月7日）
你可以看到4月份在花旗球场狂风呼啸，当时Raley投出这颗横向滑球，这颗伴随大风的滑球产生了将近三英尺的位移。难怪Luken Baker会对此挥空。在同一局中，Raley还用一记位移达28英寸的横向滑球三振了Jorge Barrosa，这是今年三振打者时产生的最大水平位移。
最快场内本垒打：Bobby Witt Jr. —— 14.13秒（5月9日）
在Statcast时代（2015年以来），只有另外两名球员绕垒速度比Witt这次场内本垒打更快——Byron Buxton有过两次（2017年的13.85秒和2016年的14.05秒）以及PCA（2024年的14.08秒）。这位皇家之星在这里的速度甚至比他2023年职业生涯首支场内本垒打所用的14.29秒还要快。
最慢本垒打慢跑：Junior Caminero —— 40.65秒（9月15日）
这是我们乐于见到的Statcast纪录。Caminero在9月份轰出这记再见本垒打后，用超过40秒的时间完成了绕垒，正式加冕慢跑之王。这位光芒超级巨星重炮手还创下了Statcast时代第二长的本垒打慢跑用时（38.66秒），那是帮助光芒杀入世界大赛的美联冠军赛第六场比赛中的本垒打。
最快三垒安打：Corbin Carroll —— 10.82秒（8月8日）
没有人能像Carroll那样跑出三垒安打。这位响尾蛇明星不仅三垒安打最多——他已经连续四个赛季领跑联盟——而且他的三垒安打速度最快。本赛季，他最出色的一次是在对阵死敌道奇的比赛中，于第九局下半敲出了扳平比分的三垒安打。
盗垒阻杀时传二垒的最快出手时间：Brandon Valenzuela —— 1.72秒（6月13日）
Valenzuela在2026赛季效力多伦多蓝鸟时迅速证明了自己作为新秀的防守球星实力，尤其是他在本垒后方的臂力。这是一次完美的传球，将试图盗二垒的Ryan McMahon抓获——平均传球出手时间接近两秒，而Valenzuela把这个纪录远远甩在了身后。
最强劲外野助杀：Carson Benge —— 103.9英里/小时（8月17日）
这可能是Benge轰动新秀赛季的代表作。这位大都会的未来之星在本垒板前先后刺杀了两名教士跑垒员——而且是在同一局里！教士本该吸取教训的，当时他的第一记传球就是一记高达99.9英里/小时的准星直传，将Jake Cronenworth刺杀出局。但他们没有……所以Benge用一枚103.9英里/小时的大炮传球将Manny Machado再次雷霆扎杀，刷新了自己的纪录。
最强劲内野助杀：Elly De La Cruz —— 102.0英里/小时（9月9日）
你很难在内野手身上看到三位数时速的臂力……除非这位内野手的名字叫“Elly De La Cruz”。这位红星凭借这记送往本垒板的火箭般中转传球，剥夺了Teoscar Hernández的一支场内本垒打——这是Statcast时代内野手有记录以来的首次三位数时速助杀。De La Cruz目前包揽了2015年以来内野手最强劲助杀的前五名——换句话说，他把自己的纪录打破了整整四次。
按catch probability计算的最佳美技接杀：Pete Crow-Armstrong —— 5%（5月30日）
这个奖项总是带有一点主观性，因为5%的接杀概率是Statcast设定的最高难度级别，每个赛季都会在这个门槛上涌现出一堆候选者。但是我们怎么能不选PCA呢？他刚刚打出了我们见过最顶级的防守赛季之一。
这是来自国联MVP的最爱——一次对阵死敌红雀的比赛中锁定胜局的接杀，当时Crow-Armstrong必须在短短4.3秒内狂奔81英尺完成滑接。PCA达到了每秒30.2英尺的顶级冲刺速度以按时赶到落点，并且他做出了极其惊人的瞬间爆发起动（比普通外野手快9.5英尺）。他做这个动作时总是显得那么潇洒。

items.titleEn: Each MLB club's best prospect acquired via trade
bodyEn: The Hot Stove has been warming up slowly, at least in terms of trades. Since the Brewers finished off the Rays in the World Series, teams have executed just three deals involving prospects currently on MLB Pipeline's organization Top 30 Prospects lists.

The Royals acquired right-hander Angel Bastardo (now No. 20 on their Top 30) from the Red Sox for infielder Jack Pineda on Nov. 17 and sent righty L.P. Langevin (No. 27 on Seattle's Top 30) to the Mariners in the six-player Maikel Garcia trade the next day. The White Sox added left-hander Sean Sullivan (No. 27) in a deal that sent Davis Martin and Luis Castillo to the Rockies on Nov. 19.

While those moves weren't quite seismic, many teams have grabbed significant prospects in trades. Below, we identify the top talents in each farm system arrived via that route, including 10 Top 100 prospects:
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: Dasan Hill, LHP (No. 7)Hill is a recent addition to Toronto’s pitching pipeline, having been acquired from the Twins at this year’s Deadline for Jeff Hoffman, and the Jays could be getting him at a good time. He has a mid-90s fastball that touches 99 already through his age-20 season, but it’s his secondaries in a low-80s slider, upper-70s curveball and mid-80s changeup that miss a ton of bats. He’s been treated carefully so far with only 123 1/3 innings through two pro seasons, and his control was an issue in his age-20 season before the trade (though he looked better at High-A Vancouver in that regard). But the raw materials are undeniable for the 6-foot-5 southpaw.

Orioles: Anthony Eyanson, RHP (No. 2/MLB No. 45)The Red Sox took Eyanson in the third round of the 2025 Draft out of LSU, then saw him show up in 2026 with vastly improved stuff. He pitched his way quickly from High-A to Double-A and went to the Futures Game, sporting a 1.32 ERA and .152 BAA, when he was sent to the Orioles in the blockbuster Adley Rutschman trade. He posted a 2.03 ERA and a 13.6 K/9 rate over six starts with Double-A Chesapeake as part of a loaded rotation that included Joseph Dzierwa and Caden Hunter.

Rays: Caden Bodine, C (No. 3/MLB No. 46)Tampa Bay picked up the former Coastal Carolina backstop from the Orioles in last offseason’s Shane Baz trade, only months after he was selected 30th overall in the 2025 Draft. Bodine went on to rank second among full-season Minor Leaguers with a .342 average and first with a 6.3 percent strikeout rate over 117 games across all four of the Rays’ full-season affiliates. He also contributed 17 homers, 16 of which came as a lefty hitter, and won the Minor League Gold Glove for his performance behind the plate. With Nick Fortes traded this month, Bodine should compete for the Rays’ backup catcher role out of the gate in ‘27.

Red Sox: John Holobetz, RHP (No. 9)The player to be named later in the May 2025 trade that sent Quinn Priester to the Brewers, Holobetz creates an exceptionally low release height and quality extension with his delivery. Those attributes help his lively 93-95 mph fastball and so-so secondary stuff play up, and he logged a 4.07 ERA with a 132/36 K/BB ratio in 119 1/3 innings between Double-A and Triple-A.

Yankees: Elmer Rodríguez, RHP (No. 2)Acquired from the Red Sox in exchange for Carlos Narváez at the 2024 Winter Meetings, Rodríguez would have led the Triple-A International League with a 2.45 ERA if he hadn't fallen a few innings short of qualifying because the Yankees called him up on five different occasions. All four of his offerings -- mid-90s fastball, upper-70s curveball, low-80s sweeper, fading upper-80s changeup -- grade as at least solid when at their best.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: Khalil Watson, OF (No. 14)With right-hander Khal Stephen (picked up from the Blue Jays in the July 2025 Shane Bieber trade) sidelined after elbow surgery, Watson gets the nod here. After floundering in the Marlins system, he has been rejuvenated and moved from the infield to the outfield since coming to the Guardians as part of an August 2023 Josh Bell deal. Watson offers solid raw power and speed to go with quality defense in center field, and he posted a .247/.361/.455 slash line with 19 homers and 24 steals in 98 Triple-A games along with posting a .605 OPS with nine steals in 27 games with Cleveland.

Royals: Lucas Braun, RHP (No. 16)Braun moved from Atlanta to Kansas City at this year’s Deadline in a deal that sent Lane Thomas and Bailey Falter the other way, and he was back in the news recently, having been added to the 40-man roster as Rule 5 protection. He’s proven to be a workhorse by Minor League standards with three consecutive seasons of 130-plus innings, and he has a control over stuff profile with an arsenal led by the fastball triforce (sinker, cutter, four-seamer in that order) with nothing sitting above the low-90s. There’s enough diversity there that Braun could still figure as a backend starter or bulk option out of the bullpen.

Tigers: Zyhir Hope, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 26)When it became clear that Tarik Skubal was headed elsewhere at this year’s Trade Deadline, speculation abounded about who would be the top prospect in the return. That ended up being Hope from the Dodgers as the 21-year-old got out of Los Angeles’ outfield jam. The left-handed slugger is a potential 30-homer threat in the bigs, thanks to his strength and ability to create good angles off the bat, and generally makes good swing decisions, though there is some whiff to his game. With his above-average speed and plus arm strength, he could be a great fit in right field alongside Max Clark in center and Riley Greene in left for Detroit by next year.

Twins: Eduardo Tait, C (No. 6)After signing for just $90,000 with the Phillies, Tait quickly became one of the game’s best young catching prospects at the lower levels. He was sent to the Twins at the 2025 Trade Deadline for Jhoan Duran, then struggled with his approach for much of his first full season with the organization, though he did hit 22 homers with High-A Cedar Rapids while playing for nearly all of 2026 at age 19.

White Sox: William Bergolla Jr., SS/2B (No. 9)The return from the Phillies in a July 2024 trade for Tanner Banks, Bergolla exudes the same contact-hitting, speed-and-defense middle-infielder profile as his father William Sr., who appeared in 17 games with the 2005 Reds. After slashing .286/.342/.333 with 40 steals in 125 games for Birmingham's Double-A championship club in 2025, he played just 11 contests this year because of a right shin contusion and a stress fracture in his right fibula.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: Arjun Nimmala, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 34)The Angels received Nimmala, the 2023 first-rounder, from the Blue Jays at this year’s Trade Deadline in return for José Soriano. He finished the year swinging a white-hot bat, homering seven times in 11 September games, then three more in the playoffs. He capped it off with a .974 OPS over 20 Arizona Fall League games.

Astros: Juan Bello, RHPSwapped straight up by the Cubs for Ryan Pressly in January 2025, Bello injured his elbow six months later and required Tommy John surgery that sidelined him for all of this season. He returned to work 13 1/3 innings (8.78 ERA, 16 strikeouts) in the Arizona Fall League, where his fastball velocity was down (88-92 mph) but his low-80s slider was effective.

Athletics: Leo De Vries, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 3)A top-ranked prospect since he was No. 1 on the 2024 international Top 50, and signing with the Padres for $4.2 million, De Vries went straight to full-season ball for his pro debut after signing. The 2025 Futures Gamer was sent as the centerpiece prospect to the A’s in return for Mason Miller. He performed very well at age 19 in Double-A (.290/.378/.458) over 93 games, though a right shoulder injury that shut him down in August was diagnosed as a torn labrum that required surgery.

Mariners: Boston Smith, C/OF (No. 13)A 2025 senior money-saving selection by the Nationals, Smith was traded to the White Sox this past spring before he had played a single professional game. He slugged his way from Single-A to Double-A rapidly, then was on the move again to the Mariners in the Luis Castillo deadline deal, making him the only player on this list to get traded twice in the same year. He hit 31 homers and finished with a combined .990 OPS along the way before finishing with some more reps in the AFL.

Rangers: Jose Corniell, RHP (No. 24)Part of a December 2020 trade that sent Rafael Montero to the Mariners, Corniell blossomed into the Rangers' Minor League pitcher of the year in 2023 before missing all of the next season with an elbow injury that required Tommy John surgery. Back and triceps issues limited him to 35 1/3 innings (6.37 ERA, 27 strikeouts) in Triple-A and two brief appearances with Texas this year, though he did sit at 94 mph and touch 97 with his fastball and displayed an improved mid-80s changeup with fade.
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: Tyler Uberstine, RHPUberstine became a Brave at this year’s Trade Deadline, coming from the Red Sox in return for Eli White. A senior 19th-round sign in 2021, the right-hander blew out his elbow two years later and missed all of 2023. He led the Red Sox organization in strikeouts in 2025 and earned a spot on the 40-man roster and made his big league debut his past April. A shoulder injury sidelined the 27-year old for much of the year and he transitioned into a relief role, throwing well (3.12 ERA in 14 games) post-trade.

Marlins: Robby Snelling, LHP (No. 2/MLB No. 49)One of the best lefty pitching prospects in the game, Snelling came from the Padres as the headline prospect in a July 2024 deal for Tanner Scott and Bryan Hoeing. He dominated Triple-A hitters with a 1.86 ERA, .116 opponent average and 44 strikeouts in 29 innings before making his big league debut in May, but he had Tommy John surgery after his first start. All four of his pitches show promise: a 93-95 mph fastball that reaches 97 with good carry, a low-80s curveball, an upper-80s changeup with fade and a mid-80s slider.

Mets: Jefferson Rojas, 3B/SS (No. 1/MLB No. 68)The Mets picked up Rojas from the Cubs at the Deadline for Clay Holmes and Tyrone Taylor, and he immediately jumped to the top of their Top 30. He showed better exit velocities and angles as a Southern League repeater in 2026, eventually finishing with 27 homers in 126 games across Double-A and Triple-A (a significant jump from his previous career best of 11). Rojas has the arm for either spot on the left side of the infield and might be the future of third base in Queens, depending on what happens with Bo Bichette.

Nationals: Jarlin Susana, RHP (No. 4/MLB No. 66)Susana hadn’t pitched for the Padres above complex ball when he was included in the Juan Soto blockbuster four years ago. The 6-foot-6 right-hander may have been a lottery ticket at the time because of his big-time velocity, but as he’s climbed, his reputation as one of the most electric arms in the Minors has only grown. Susana regularly sits in the triple-digits with both his four-seamer and sinker, and he touched 104 mph in this year’s Triple-A National Championship. His mid-80s curveball is another huge weapon as a change of pace, and he worked on adding a sweeper and cutter in the Arizona Fall League, where he made up for innings lost to last year’s lat surgery.

Phillies: Moisés Chace, RHP (No. 13)Sent by the Orioles to the Phillies in the Gregory Soto deal at the 2024 Trade Deadline, it looked like the Phillies were getting Chace right when he was clicking (3.59 ERA, 13.9 K/9, .200 BAA), but he’s thrown just 16 2/3 innings over the last two years combined due to Tommy John surgery. The Phillies non-tendered him this offseason then immediately re-signed him to a Minor League deal so he’ll be able to pitch all of the 2027 season.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: Jett Williams, 3B/SS/OF (No. 10)Acquired along with Brandon Sproat as the Freddy Peralta return from the Mets last offseason, Williams had his first season with the Crew marred by multiple issues with his right wrist, which had been previously surgically repaired. He slashed just .233/.340/.384 with nine homers and 21 steals in 81 games for Triple-A Nashville and got additional looks in the Arizona Fall League before being added to the 40-man roster this month. When he’s on, Williams has borderline plus-plus speed and can make something of his average raw power with pull-and-lift tendencies. He may best fit Milwaukee’s plans as a fast utilityman in ‘27 and beyond.

Cardinals: Jesús Báez, SS/2B (No. 15)St. Louis has become loaded with trade acquisitions as the Cards have bulked out the farm with the likes of Alexander Frias, Josiah Ragsdale, Brandon Clarke, Tekoah Roby, Tai Peete among several others. But coming off a breakout 2026 season, Báez – a pickup from the Mets for Ryan Helsley in 2025 – seems to have emerged as the most notable of the bunch. He crushed 39 homers (second-most in the Minors) across 113 games at High-A and Double-A last year with the improved exit velocities to match, though he did become more aggressive with his swing decisions in search of that power. His arm is an absolute asset on the dirt and should help his chances of sticking on the left side.

Cubs: NoneThe Cubs have spent the last two years trading for veterans and haven't targeted prospects in a deal since sending Mark Leiter Jr. to the Yankees in exchange for infielder Ben Cowles and right-hander Jack Neely in July 2024. Both have made the Cubs Top 30 in the past and remain in the organization, but Cowles had a down year in Triple-A and Neely missed the entire season.

Pirates: Edgleen Perez, C/1B (No. 10)When the Pirates sent David Bednar to the Yankees at the 2025 Trade Deadline, they received three prospects in return, including Perez, a glove-first backstop. He does make excellent swing decisions, albeit without much impact at present, and was making a promising step forward with Single-A Bradenton in 2026, hitting .296 with a .385 OBP over 77 games when he suffered a season-ending hand injury at the end of July. He’ll begin the 2027 season at age 20.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter

Reds: Arnaldo Lantigua, OF (No. 18)The Dodgers really wanted to sign Roki Sasaki in 2025, but they needed more international bonus pool money. So they shipped Lantigua, who they had signed for around $700K in 2023, to the Reds in return for $1.5 million for the Sasaki Fund. He made his stateside debut with his new organization in 2025, playing his way from the Arizona Complex League to Single-A Daytona. A rough start back in Daytona in 2026 led to a return to the complex, but he got straightened out and returned to the Tortugas and slashed .324/.412/.532 over 30 games from Aug. 1 through the end of the season, including the Florida State League playoffs.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backs: David Hagaman, RHP (No. 4)Hagaman underwent internal brace surgery in May 2024, was drafted by the Rangers in the fourth round that summer and was dealt to the D-backs a year later as part of a Merrill Kelly Deadline deal. He was healthy and productive in his first full season as an Arizona prospect in 2026, finishing with a 2.87 ERA and 132 strikeouts in 106 2/3 innings at High-A and Double-A. Pitching with impressive extension, Hagaman can sit 93-95 mph with his four-seamer, and his slider and curveball both miss a ton of bats. Should form hold, he should be in line to contribute to the Snakes’ rotation depth in ‘27.

Dodgers: Mike Sirota, OF (No. 3/MLB No. 17)Not only did the Dodgers steal Sirota from the Reds in the Gavin Lux trade in January 2025, but Los Angeles also received a supplemental first-round pick that it turned into another Top 100 Prospect (Charles Davalan). A five-tool center fielder, Sirota ranked second in the Minors in on-base percentage and wRC+ (162) while slashing .307/.461/.526 with 17 homers and 13 steals in 108 games as he advanced from High-A to Triple-A. The grand-nephew of Whitey Ford, he helped lead Oklahoma City to the Pacific Coast League title and the Triple-A National Championship.

Giants: Ramon Marquez, RHP (No. 5/MLB No. 94)The Giants have made a habit of acquiring pitching prospects in trades, most notably Marquez, part of a package from the Phillies for Luis Arraez and Caleb Kilian in August. Armed with a mid-90s fastball and a dastardly low-80s changeup with huge fade, he compiled a 2.22 ERA, .162 opponent average and 105/20 K/BB ratio in 69 innings between two Class A levels before having surgery to repair a small fracture in his elbow.

Padres: Jorge Quintana, SS (No. 11)Known primarily for dealing away prospects in droves as part of Major League deals, the Padres do, in fact, have a selection here in Quintana, who they got from the Brewers alongside Nestor Cortes for Brandon Lockridge in 2025. He’s shown loud contact for his age as a 19-year-old switch-hitter, and he has enough glove and arm to be given long looks at the shortstop position. Quintana’s profile is still based more on projection than current production after he hit .234/.328/.367 in 103 games for Single-A Lake Elsinore in his age-19 season last summer, and improving his contact rates should be a point of emphasis.

Rockies: Roc Riggio, 2B (No. 12)A fourth-round pick of the Yankees in 2024, Riggio struggled out of the gate as a pro, but shook off an early hand injury in 2025 to reach Double-A when he was sent to the Rockies at the Trade Deadline for Jake Bird. He played his way from Double-A to Triple-A in his first full season with Colorado, finishing with a combined .869 OPS while turning in a 20-20 season (22 homers, 21 steals). He was somewhat surprisingly not added to the Rockies’ 40-man roster this offseason.
items.titleZh: 盘点各支MLB球队通过交易获得的最强潜力新秀
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点30支MLB球队通过交易获得的最佳农场新秀，涵盖多位百大新秀。多伦多蓝鸟由左投Dasan Hill领衔。
bodyZh: 冬日热灶正在慢慢升温，至少在球员交易方面是如此。自从密尔沃基酿酒人在世界大赛中击败坦帕湾光芒以来，各队仅完成了三笔涉及目前处于MLB Pipeline组织前30大潜力新秀榜单上球员的交易。

堪萨斯城皇家在11月17日从波士顿红袜换来右投手Angel Bastardo（目前在其前30榜单中排名第20位），送出了内野手Jack Pineda；并在第二天六人交易中将右投手L.P. Langevin（西雅图前30第27位）送往西雅图水手。芝加哥白袜在11月19日通过一笔将Davis Martin和Luis Castillo送往科罗拉多洛矶的交易，得到了左投手Sean Sullivan（第27位）。
虽然这些运作算不上惊天动地，但许多球队通过交易捕获了重要的潜力新秀。以下我们将盘点各农场系统中通过该途径引进的顶级天赋，其中包括10位百大新秀：
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区

多伦多蓝鸟：Dasan Hill，左投手（第7位）Hill是多伦多投球阵营的新面孔，他在今年的交易截止日前夕作为换取Jeff Hoffman的筹码从明尼苏达双城加盟，蓝鸟得到他或许正逢其时。他在20岁时就能投出90英里中段并在极少数情况下达到99英里的直球，而他那80英里初段的滑球、70英里后段的曲球以及80英里中段的变速球才是能够大量三振打者的利器。到目前为止，他在两年的职业生涯中仅投了123 1/3局，受到了保护，并且在交易前的20岁赛季，控球曾是个问题（尽管他在高阶1A温哥华的表现看起来有所改善）。不过对于这位身高6尺5寸的左投来说，他的原始天赋是不容置疑的。

巴尔的摩金莺：Anthony Eyanson，右投手（第2/MLB第45位）红袜在2025年选秀第三轮从LSU选中Eyanson，随后发现他在2026年展现出大幅度提升的球威。当他在重磅交易中被送往金莺时，他迅速从高阶1A升上2A并入选未来之星赛，交出1.32自责分率和.152对战打击率的亮眼成绩。在2A切萨皮克的六场先发中，他投出了2.03的自责分率和13.6的K/9率，身处包括Joseph Dzierwa和Caden Hunter在内的豪华先发轮值中。

坦帕湾光芒：Caden Bodine，捕手（第3/MLB第46位）坦帕湾在去年休赛期涉及Shane Baz的交易中从金莺得到了这位前海岸卡罗莱纳大学的捕手，当时距离他在2025年选秀大会上首轮第30顺位被选中仅仅几个月。Bodine在光芒全部四个全赛季附属球队的117场比赛中，以.342的打击率在全赛季小联盟球员中排名第二，并以6.3%的三振率排名第一。他还贡献了17记本垒打，其中16记来自左打，并因其在捕手位置上的防守表现赢得了小联盟金手套奖。随着Nick Fortes本月被交易，Bodine有望在27赛季直接竞争光芒的替补捕手角色。
波士顿红袜：John Holobetz，右投手（第9位）作为2025年5月将Quinn Priester送到酿酒人的交易中待定球员（PTBNL），Holobetz在投球时展现出极低的出手点和优质的延伸度。这些特质帮助他生动的93-95英里直球和一般的变化球发挥出威力，他在2A和3A之间出赛119 1/3局，交出4.07自责分率以及132比36的K/BB比。

纽约洋基：Elmer Rodríguez，右投手（第2位）在2024年冬季会议上作为交换Carlos Narváez的筹码从红袜获得，如果不是因为洋基五次将他升上大联盟导致投球局数稍差一点未能达到资格，Rodríguez本可以凭借2.45的自责分率领跑3A国际联盟。他的四种球路——90英里中段的直球、70英里后段的曲球、80英里初段的横扫球以及80英里后段渐变的变速球——在发挥最佳时至少都达到扎实的评级。
美国联盟中区

克利夫兰守护者：Khalil Watson，外野手（第14位）由于右投手Khal Stephen（在2025年7月Shane Bieber交易中从蓝鸟获得）因手肘手术缺阵，Watson在此入选。在迈阿密马林鱼体系中沉沦后，他在2023年8月作为Josh Bell交易的一部分加盟守护者以来，焕发新生并从内野转至外野。Watson拥有扎实的原始力量和速度，以及中外野的高质量防守，他在3A的98场比赛中交出.247/.361/.455的打击三围，带有19记本垒打和24次盗垒，在克利夫兰的27场比赛中也交出.605的OPS和9次盗垒。

堪萨斯城皇家：Lucas Braun，右投手（第16位）Braun在今年的交易截止日从亚特兰大转投堪萨斯城，这是一笔将Lane Thomas和Bailey Falter送往对家的交易，他最近再次成为新闻焦点，作为规则五保护被加入40人名单。以小联盟标准来看，他已被证明是一名劳模，连续三个赛季投球局数超过130局，他拥有以直球三件套（依次为伸卡球、卡特球、四缝线直球）为主的控球型球威体系，球速均未超过90英里初段。由于具备足够的球路多样性，Braun未来仍有可能成为牛棚后段的先发或吃局数选项。

底特律老虎：Zyhir Hope，外野手（第1/MLB第26位）当Tarik Skubal在本赛季交易截止日确定离队时，关于回报中头号新秀是谁的猜测甚嚣尘上。最终人选是从道奇队换来的Hope，这位21岁球员得以摆脱洛杉矶的外野拥挤。这位左打重炮凭借其力量和制造绝佳击球角度的能力，有望成为大联盟中30轰级别的威胁，且他的挥棒决策通常不错，尽管比赛中仍存在一些空挥。凭借其高于平均的速度和出色的臂力，他明年有望在底特律与中外野的Max Clark和左外野的Riley Greene并肩作战，完美契合右外野。
明尼苏达双城：Eduardo Tait，捕手（第6位）以仅9万美元的签约金与费城人签约后，Tait迅速成为低阶联盟中全美最优秀的年轻捕手新秀之一。他在2025年交易截止日作为交易Jhoan Duran的筹码被送往双城，随后在他的第一个完整赛季的大部分时间里都在应对进攻策略上的挣扎，尽管他在2026年以19岁的年龄几乎打满全季，在高阶1A锡达拉皮兹击出22记本垒打。

芝加哥白袜：William Bergolla Jr.，游击手/二垒手（第9位）作为2024年7月用Tanner Banks交易自费城人的回报，Bergolla散发出与其父William Sr.（曾在2005年红人队出场17场比赛）相同的球风，皆为擅长安打、速度与防守兼备的中线内野手。在2025年伯明翰2A冠军球队的125场比赛中交出.286/.342/.333的打击三围和40次盗垒后，他今年由于右小腿挫伤和右腓骨应力性骨折仅出战了11场比赛。
美国联盟西区
洛杉矶天使：Arjun Nimmala，游击手（第1/MLB第34位）天使在今年的交易截止日用José Soriano作筹码，从蓝鸟换来了这位2023年的首轮秀Nimmala。他以火热的打击状态结束了这一年，在9月份的11场比赛中轰出7记本垒打，随后在季后赛中又添3轰。他在亚利桑那秋季联赛的20场比赛中以.974的OPS完美收官。
休斯敦太空人：Juan Bello，右投手在2025年1月与小熊直接交换Ryan Pressly的交易中加盟，Bello在六个月后手肘受伤，接受了汤米约翰手术，导致他缺席了本赛季的所有比赛。他在亚利桑那秋季联赛复出投了13 1/3局（防御率8.78，16次三振），在那里他的直球球速有所下降（88-92英里），但其80英里初段的滑球依然有效。

运动家：Leo De Vries，游击手（第1/MLB第3位）自从在2024年国际球员前50榜单中排名第一并以420万美元与教士签约以来，De Vries一直名列顶级新秀，他在签约后直接进入职业生涯的全赛季比赛。这位2025年未来之星赛球员作为核心筹码被送往运动家，以换取Mason Miller。他在2A以19岁的年龄在93场比赛中表现非常出色（.290/.378/.458），尽管8月份因右肩受伤导致赛季报销，被诊断为关节唇撕裂并需要接受手术。

西雅图水手：Boston Smith，捕手/外野手（第13位）作为国民队在2025年的高额签约金精选球员，Smith在今年春天甚至还未打过一场职业比赛就被交易到了白袜。他一路从1A迅猛晋升至2A，随后在Luis Castillo的交易截止日交易中再次转会至水手，使他成为这份名单中唯一在同一年内被交易两次的球员。一路上他轰出31记本垒打，最终综合OPS达到.990，随后在秋季联赛中进行了更多比赛的磨炼。

得克萨斯游骑兵：Jose Corniell，右投手（第24位）作为2020年12月将Rafael Montero送往水手的交易的一部分，Corniell在2023年绽放光芒，当选游骑兵小联盟年度最佳投手，随后因需要接受汤米约翰手术的手肘伤势错过了接下来整个赛季。背部和三头肌的问题将他今年的出场限制在3A的35 1/3局（6.37自责分率，27次三振）以及在得克萨斯的两次短暂亮相，尽管他的直球确实能维持在94英里并达到97英里，且展现出带有下沉轨迹的改进版80英里中段变速球。
国家联盟东区

亚特兰大勇士：Tyler Uberstine，右投手Uberstine在今年的交易截止日成为勇士球员，从红袜加盟以换取Eli White。作为2021年第19轮被选中的大学毕业球员，这位右投手在两年后手肘韧带撕裂，错过了整个2023赛季。他在2025年领跑红袜组织的三振榜，赢得了40人名单的一席之地，并在今年4月完成了大联盟首秀。肩伤导致这位27岁球员缺席了大部分赛季，他随后转型为后援角色，交易后投球表现优异（14场比赛防御率3.12）。

迈阿密马林鱼：Robby Snelling，左投手（第2/MLB第49位）作为比赛中最优秀的左投新秀之一，Snelling在2024年7月作为交易Tanner Scott和Bryan Hoeing的重磅筹码从教士加盟。他在29局中以1.86的自责分率、.116的对战打击率和44次三振统治了3A打者，并在5月完成了大联盟首秀，但在他的第一场先发后接受了汤米约翰手术。他的四种球路都展现出极高潜力：93-95英里且能达到97英里并带有极佳上浮轨迹的直球、80英里初段的曲球、80英里后段带有下沉轨迹的变速球以及80英里中段的滑球。

纽约大都会：Jefferson Rojas，三垒手/游击手（第1/MLB第68位）大都会在交易截止日用Clay Holmes和Tyrone Taylor从小熊手中换来Rojas，他随即跻身大都会前30大新秀榜首。作为南方联盟的2026年老面孔，他展现出更好的击球初速和角度，最终在2A和3A的126场比赛中轰出27记本垒打（与他先前职业生涯最高纪录的11记相比有了显著飞跃）。Rojas具备镇守内野左侧任一位置的臂力，并且根据Bo Bichette的去留，他可能会成为皇后区未来的三垒手。

华盛顿国民：Jarlin Susana，右投手（第4/MLB第66位）四年前被纳入Juan Soto的重磅交易时，Susana在教士队的最高层级还未超过新人联盟。这位身高6尺5寸的右投手当时可能只是因为其惊人的球速而像一张彩票，但随着他不断晋升，他作为小联盟最电光石火的球臂之一的声誉也与日俱增。Susana的四缝线和伸卡球经常能维持在三位数球速，并在今年3A全国冠军赛中达到了104英里。他80英里中段的曲球作为变速手段是另一大杀器，他还在亚利桑那秋季联赛中致力于增加横扫球和卡特球，以此弥补去年背阔肌手术所损失的投球局数。

费城人：Moisés Chace，右投手（第13位）在2024年交易截止日Gregory Soto的交易中被金莺送到费城人时，看起来费城人正好在Chace状态正佳时得到了他（3.59自责分率，13.9 K/9，.200对战打击率），但由于汤米约翰手术，他在过去两年里总共只投了16 2/3局。费城人在这个休赛期对他取消了薪资仲裁资格（non-tender），但随即又与他重新签下一份小联盟合约，以便他能够投满整个2027赛季。
国家联盟中区

密尔沃基酿酒人：Jett Williams，三垒手/游击手/外野手（第10位）作为上休赛期从大都会交易Freddy Peralta的回报与Brandon Sproat一同加盟，Williams在酿酒人的首个赛季因右腕（此前曾做过手术）多次出现问题而受阻。他在3A纳什维尔的81场比赛中仅交出.233/.340/.384的打击三围，带有9记本垒打和21次盗垒，在被本月加入40人名单之前，还在亚利桑那秋季联赛中获得了更多考察机会。当他状态在线时，Williams具备接近双加（plus-plus）的速度，并且凭借其拉打倾向能够将一般的原始力量转化为实际产出。他在2027年及以后或许最适合作为密尔沃基计划中的快腿超级替补。

圣路易斯红雀：Jesús Báez，游击手/二垒手（第15位）圣路易斯通过交易获得了大批新秀，充实了农场体系，其中包括Alexander Frias、Josiah Ragsdale、Brandon Clarke、Tekoah Roby、Tai Peete等多人。但在经历了一个爆发性的2026赛季后，Báez——这位2025年为换取Ryan Helsley从大都会引进的球员——似乎已经成为这群人中最引人注目的一位。去年他在高阶1A和2A的113场比赛中轰出39记本垒打（小联盟第二多），并伴随着匹配的更佳击球初速，尽管为了追求这种力量他在挥棒决策上变得更具侵略性。他的手臂绝对是内野的一大资产，并应有助于提高他留在内野左侧的机会。
芝加哥小熊：无小熊在过去两年里一直在通过交易换取老将，自2024年7月将Mark Leiter Jr.送到洋基以换取内野手Ben Cowles和右投手Jack Neely以来，就再也没有将潜力新秀作为交易目标。两人过去都曾进入小熊前30大新秀榜并仍留在组织内，但Cowles在3A度过了一个低迷的赛季，而Neely则缺席了整个赛季。

匹兹堡海盗：Edgleen Perez，捕手/一垒手（第10位）当海盗在2025年交易截止日将David Bednar送到洋基时，他们收到了三名新秀作为回报，其中包括Perez这位防守优先的捕手。他确实做出了极佳的挥棒决策，尽管目前缺乏足够的打击破坏力，且在2026年随1A布雷登顿取得了有希望的进步，在77场比赛中打出.296的打击率和.385的上垒率，却在7月底遭遇了导致赛季报销的手部伤势。他将在2027赛季开始时年满20岁。
订阅MLB Pipeline通讯

辛辛那提红人：Arnaldo Lantigua，外野手（第18位）道奇队在2025年非常想签下佐佐木朗希（Roki Sasaki），但他们需要更多的国际球员签约金额度。因此，他们将这位在2023年以约70万美元签下的Lantigua送到了红人，以换取150万美元的佐佐木基金。他在2025年在新组织完成了美国本土首秀，一路从亚利桑那新人联盟打到1A代托纳。2026年在代托纳的不顺开局导致他重回新人联盟，但他调整好了状态并重返乌龟队，从8月1日到赛季结束（包括佛罗里达州联盟季后赛）的30场比赛中交出.324/.412/.532的打击三围。
国家联盟西区

亚利桑那响尾蛇：David Hagaman，右投手（第4位）Hagaman于2024年5月接受了内部支具（internal brace）手术，当年夏天在第四轮被游击手选中，并在一年后作为Merrill Kelly交易截止日交易的一部分被送往响尾蛇。他在2026年作为响尾蛇新秀的首个完整赛季中保持健康并产出高效，在高阶1A和2A的106 2/3局中以2.87的自责分率和132次三振收官。Hagaman拥有令人印象深刻的投球延伸度，其四缝线直球能维持在93-95英里，滑球和曲球都能制造大量三振。如果保持现状，他有望在27赛季为响尾蛇的先发轮值深度做出贡献。

洛杉矶道奇：Mike Sirota，外野手（第3/MLB第17位）道奇不仅在2025年1月的Gavin Lux交易中从红人手中“偷走”了Sirota，洛杉矶还得到了一个补充首轮选秀权，并将其转化为另一位百大新秀（Charles Davalan）。作为一名五拍子中外野手，Sirota在从小联盟高阶1A升至3A的108场比赛中，以.307/.461/.526的打击三围、17记本垒打和13次盗垒，在小联盟的上垒率和wRC+（162）均排名第二。作为Whitey Ford的曾侄子，他帮助俄克拉何马城夺得太平洋海岸联盟冠军和3A全国冠军。

旧金山巨人：Ramon Marquez，右投手（第5/MLB第94位）巨人队已经养成了通过交易获取投球新秀的习惯，其中最引人注目的是Marquez，他作为8月份为换取Luis Arraez和Caleb Kilian从费城人得到的打包筹码之一。他拥有90英里中段的直球和带有巨大下沉轨迹的刁钻80英里初段变速球，在两个A级联盟级别的69局中，交出了2.22的自责分率、.162的对战打击率以及105比20的K/BB比，随后接受了修复手肘小骨折的手术。

圣迭戈教士：Jorge Quintana，游击手（第11位）以在大联盟交易中成批送走新秀而闻名，教士队阵中确实有Quintana这位入选者，他们是在2025年用Brandon Lockridge从酿酒人那里换来Nestor Cortes时顺便得到的。作为一名19岁的两栖打者，他展现出了惊人的球棒接触能力，并拥有足够的手套和臂力，足以在游击手位置上获得长期的考察。Quintana的评定在去年夏天以19岁年龄在1A埃尔西诺湖的103场比赛中交出.234/.328/.367的成绩后，依然更多基于未来预测而非当前产出，提高球棒接触率应当是一个重点强调的方向。

科罗拉多洛矶：Roc Riggio，二垒手（第12位）作为洋基在2024年的第四轮选秀顺位，Riggio在职业生涯初期举步维艰，但在2025年摆脱了早期的手部伤势，一路杀入2A，当时他在交易截止日被送到洛矶以换取Jake Bird。他在科罗拉多的第一个完整赛季中从2A打到3A，综合OPS达到.869，同时完成了20-20赛季（22轰，21盗）。令人略感意外的是，他在这个休赛期并未被加入洛矶的40人名单中。
