items.titleEn: What will Valenzuela's role be in 2027?
bodyEn: Brandon Valenzuela wasn’t supposed to have a big role for the Blue Jays in 2026. Acquired from the Padres for infielder Will Wagner at the 2025 Trade Deadline, the young catcher spent the rest of the season at Triple-A Buffalo and started the 2026 campaign there, too.

But when Alejandro Kirk fractured and dislocated his left thumb on a foul tip just five games into the season, it was Valenzuela’s time to shine. Called up to make his MLB debut, the 25-year-old got the lion’s share of playing time at catcher while Kirk was on the shelf for more than two months. When Kirk returned from the injured list, Toronto traded Tyler Heineman to the Angels for cash and rolled with the rookie Valenzuela as its primary backup catcher. When all was said and done, Kirk and Valenzuela each started an identical 68 games.

Unless Kirk misses time again, Valenzuela’s role likely won’t be quite as big for the Blue Jays in 2027. But as a standout defender who showed some promise with the bat, he should remain one of the most valuable backup catchers in the big leagues.
Here’s a look at Valenzuela’s rookie campaign and what his role for Toronto might look like next season.
What happened in 2026?.222/.307/.372 slash line, 9 HR, 23 RBI in 91 G (271 PA)

At the plate, Valenzuela put up better numbers than might be expected for a rookie catcher in his first taste of the big leagues. Although his .679 OPS (87 OPS+) was below average overall, Valenzuela’s numbers were far more palatable when considering his position. In 2026, primary catchers combined for a .230/.304/.382 slash line, very similar to Valenzuela’s offensive production.

Statcast quality-of-contact metrics such as expected wOBA, expected batting average and expected slugging percentage back up Valenzuela’s below-average year with the bat, but there is some encouraging news under the hood. For one, Valenzuela’s .303 actual wOBA was lower than his .313 xwOBA, indicating a bit of bad luck. Also, while his strikeout rate ran high at 25.5%, he walked at an above-average 10.7% clip and was also better than league average in terms of chase rate (28.5%).

Valenzuela’s power production was quite respectable, too. Driven by a 23.8% pulled airball rate -- well above the MLB average of 16.9% -- he managed to slug nine homers in 91 games, which comes out to 16 dingers over 162 contests. With plus bat speed at 72.6 mph and an encouraging 37.8% launch angle sweet-spot rate that showed he was able to routinely elevate the ball, Valenzuela could be capable of even more power in the coming years.
Key stat+12 fielding run value (T-3rd among catchers)
While Valenzuela’s offensive potential is one thing, it’s worth noting he has already cemented himself among the most skilled defensive catchers in the Majors as well.

Valenzuela proved to be one of MLB’s best pitch framers in 2026, an art that is still valuable despite the recent advent of the ABS challenge system. He tied the Tigers’ Dillon Dingler -- the AL Gold Glove Award winner at catcher -- for the most framing runs in MLB at +9. (Kirk was right behind, tied with the Yankees’ Austin Wells for third at +7).

While Kirk is an excellent pitch blocker -- the best in MLB in 2026 -- he does not possess a particularly strong throwing arm. Valenzuela is the opposite: He rates out as a below-average blocker, but he tied Miami’s Joe Mack for the MLB lead in ’26 with +8 caught stealing above average, which worked out to five runs prevented for the Blue Jays.

With the ability to deploy both Kirk and Valenzuela behind the plate, it’s little wonder the Blue Jays led MLB with a +29 fielding run value from their catchers in 2026, with the Yankees a distant second at +18. Although Kirk’s blocking skill is crucial, Valenzuela was just as big a part of that defensive success at a crucial position.
Biggest question for 2027How much will he play?

A 2027 campaign roughly equal to his rookie season would be a clear-cut success for Valenzuela and the Blue Jays. After all, he racked up 2.1 FanGraphs WAR in 2026, tied for 13th among primary catchers -- and not far behind Kirk, who had 2.8 fWAR.

But will Valenzuela really see as much playing time next season as he did in ’26? Once Kirk came off the IL, he started more than twice as many games behind the plate as did Valenzuela (63 and 30, respectively). And neither spent much time at designated hitter, where Kirk started just three times and Valenzuela only once.

Needless to say, it’s good for the Blue Jays to have a capable option behind Kirk at perhaps the most physically demanding position on the diamond. Gone are the days of catchers starting nearly every game: The Phillies’ J.T. Realmuto led the Majors in 2026 with just 122 starts at catcher, despite missing time due to back spasms.

Healthy apart from a concussion that resulted in a minimum seven-day IL stint, Kirk started 111 games behind the plate during the 2025 regular season (before catching all 18 of the Blue Jays’ postseason games). Toronto’s catching depth was aided by a career year from Heineman, who slashed a surprising .289/.361/.416 in 61 games.
items.titleZh: Valenzuela 在 2027 赛季的角色会是什么？
items.summaryZh: 展望 Brandon Valenzuela 在多伦多蓝鸟 2027 赛季的角色与定位。
bodyZh: Brandon Valenzuela 本不应该在 2026 赛季为多伦多蓝鸟扮演重要角色。在 2025 年交易截止日从圣迭戈教士交易得到内野手 Will Wagner 后，这位年轻捕手在 3A 水牛城度过了那个赛季的剩余时间，并在那里开启了 2026 赛季。

但当 Alejandro Kirk 在赛季仅进行了五场比赛时因接捕界外球导致左手拇指骨折并脱臼，Valenzuela 迎来了大放异彩的时刻。这位 25 岁球员被升上大联盟迎来生涯首秀，在 Kirk 进入伤病名单缺阵两个多月期间，他承担了大部分的捕手出场时间。当 Kirk 从伤病名单回归后，多伦多将 Tyler Heineman 交易给洛杉矶天使换取现金，并由菜鸟 Valenzuela 担任主力替补捕手。最终，Kirk 和 Valenzuela 各自先发了相同的 68 场比赛。
除非 Kirk 再次缺阵，否则 Valenzuela 在 2027 赛季对多伦多蓝鸟的角色可能不会那么吃重。但作为一名出色的防守球员，并且在打击端展现出一些潜力，他应该依然是大联盟中最有价值的替补捕手之一。
以下是关于 Valenzuela 菜鸟赛季的回顾，以及他下赛季在多伦多可能扮演的角色。
2026 赛季回顾：打击率 .222 / 上垒率 .307 / 长打率 .372，9 支本垒打，23 分打点，出赛 91 场（271 个打席）
在打击区上，对于一位初尝大联盟滋味的菜鸟捕手而言，Valenzuela 交出的数据比预期要好。尽管他的 .679 OPS（87 OPS+）总体低于平均水平，但考虑到他的守备位置，Valenzuela 的数据要显得温和得多。在 2026 赛季，主力捕手们的整体打击三围为 .230/.304/.382，与 Valenzuela 的进攻表现非常相似。

Statcast 的击球品质指标（如预期加权上垒率 xwOBA、预期打击率和预期长打率）印证了 Valenzuela 在进攻端低于平均水平的赛季表现，但数据背后也有一些令人鼓舞的消息。首先，Valenzuela 实际的 .303 wOBA 低于其 .313 的 xwOBA，这表明他有些运气不佳。此外，虽然他的三振率高达 25.5%，但他的保送率达到了高于平均水平的 10.7%，并且在追打坏球率（28.5%）方面也优于联盟平均水平。
Valenzuela 的长打火力也相当可观。在 23.8% 的拉打高飞球率推动下——远高于 16.9% 的 MLB 平均水平——他在 91 场比赛中轰出了 9 支本垒打，折算下来在 162 场比赛中可以轰出 16 轰。凭借 72.6 英里/小时的优异挥棒速度以及 37.8% 令人鼓舞的击球初速甜蜜点率（显示他能够常规性地将球打高），Valenzuela 在未来几年可能会展现出更强的长打能力。
关键数据：+12 守备跑分价值（并列捕手全 MLB 第 3）
尽管 Valenzuela 的进攻潜力是一方面，但值得一提的是，他已经巩固了自己在大联盟中最具技术的防守捕手之一的地位。

Valenzuela 证明了自己是 2026 赛季 MLB 最出色的好球带边缘偷好球（pitch framing）捕手之一，尽管近年引入了 ABS 挑战系统，这项艺术依然极具价值。他的偷好球跑分（framing runs）达到 +9，与底特律老虎的 Dillon Dingler——美联捕手金手套奖得主——并列 MLB 第一。（Kirk 紧随其后，以 +7 与纽约洋基的 Austin Wells 并列第三）。
虽然 Kirk 是一名极佳的挡球手——2026 赛季全 MLB 最强——但他并没有特别强的传球臂力。Valenzuela 则恰恰相反：他的挡球评级低于平均水平，但在 2026 赛季以 +8 的超越平均阻杀跑分（caught stealing above average）与迈阿密的主 Joe Mack 并列 MLB 第一，这为多伦多蓝鸟阻止了 5 分失分。
凭借同时拥有 Kirk 和 Valenzuela 坐镇本垒板的能力，难怪多伦多蓝鸟在 2026 赛季以来自捕手的 +29 守备跑分价值领跑 MLB，洋基以 +18 遥居第二。尽管 Kirk 的挡球技术至关重要，但 Valenzuela 在这个关键位置上的防守成功同样居功至伟。
2027 赛季的最大疑问：他能出场多少比赛？
对于 Valenzuela 和多伦多蓝鸟来说，一个大致与其菜鸟赛季相当的 2027 赛季将是一个明确的成功。毕竟，他在 2026 赛季累积了 2.1 的 FanGraphs 胜利贡献值（WAR），在主力捕手中并列第 13 位——距离拥有 2.8 fWAR 的 Kirk 相去不远。
但 Valenzuela 在下赛季真的能获得像 2026 赛季那样多的出场时间吗？一旦 Kirk 离开伤病名单，他先发镇守本垒板的场次是 Valenzuela 的两倍多（分别为 63 场和 30 场）。而且两人都没有花太多时间担任指定打击，其中 Kirk 仅先发 3 次，Valenzuela 只有 1 次。
不用说，对于多伦多蓝鸟来说，在棒球场上这个身体消耗最大的位置上，在 Kirk 身后拥有一个有能力的备选方案是一件好事。捕手几乎每场比赛都先发的日子已经一去不复返了：费城费城人的 J.T. Realmuto 尽管因背部痉挛缺席了一段时间，但在 2026 赛季仍以 122 次捕手先发领跑大联盟。
除了因脑震荡导致至少 7 天伤病名单 stint 之外保持健康，Kirk 在 2025 常规赛期间曾先发 111 场比赛（在此之前接捕了多伦多蓝鸟全部 18 场季后赛）。多伦多捕手深度得益于 Heineman 职业生涯爆发年的助力，他在 61 场比赛中交出了惊艳的 .289/.361/.416 打击三围。

items.titleEn: One big splash down, but Blue Jays still need to be bold
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Finally, it’s time to ask what comes next.

The Blue Jays officially launched their offseason retool Tuesday by agreeing to a five-year, $80 million deal with Japanese righty Kaima Taira, who immediately becomes the most interesting player on this roster, but that’s just the beginning.

A 79-83 season with the worst offense in Major League Baseball doesn’t call for a quick fix. It calls for an overhaul, including multiple upgrades to the Blue Jays’ lineup. Taira’s addition gives this rotation a chance to be truly elite, but in the days and months ahead, the Blue Jays still have some work to do.
This is where it stands 24 hours after the agreement with Taira:
In the lineup: It’s time to be bold
With each passing day, Seiya Suzuki looks like a better fit for this organization. Sometimes, we don’t need to overcomplicate the offseason.

Suzuki made sense one month ago, he made sense yesterday and he makes sense today. It’s arguably the cleanest fit since the Blue Jays lined up with George Springer six years ago, and frankly, the contract could end up looking awfully similar (just ideally not stretching to a sixth season).

Desperately needing power and with a clear opening for a corner outfielder, the Blue Jays line up so naturally here and Suzuki only costs money. The trade market will also offer plenty of opportunities -- and that landscape could change depending on the next CBA -- but in Suzuki, the Blue Jays have an opportunity to significantly upgrade their offense without skimming more off their farm system, which has shown serious improvements.

Suzuki’s five seasons with the Cubs have been remarkably consistent since he came over from Japan, where he starred for the Hiroshima Carp. He’s a career .269 hitter with a .351 on-base percentage and .823 OPS, capable of hitting 25-plus home runs each season. You can almost think of this as a midway point between Springer’s ‘25 and ‘26 seasons, and project Suzuki to hit anywhere from second to fourth in the lineup.

Jazz Chisholm Jr. certainly qualifies as “bold,” too. The money will surely come in south of Suzuki’s deal, but if you’re chasing offensive upside and baserunning potential like the Blue Jays are, a lot of big red arrows point toward Chisholm. Ernie Clement could still run for prime minister tomorrow, so any move at second base would immediately raise eyebrows, but Clement’s great athleticism would still allow for him to be a regular in the lineup.

That’s when this conversation approaches a cliff, though. Hitters like Suzuki, Chisholm, Randy Arozarena and Brandon Lowe will represent clear offensive upgrades to just about any team they join. The tier of hitters below that, however, brings us to a point of diminishing returns. How much of an upgrade would a B-tier hitter really be over Clement or Nathan Lukes, for example, and is that shot at a marginal upgrade worth the cash? Gleyber Torres is a useful example here, a fine player who will find a role somewhere, but the potential for a “gain” doesn’t feel present in Toronto.

The Blue Jays need to chase upside and ceiling here, as they did with Taira in the rotation. If they can’t find that in this current tier of hitters, a pivot to the trade market -- and perhaps a little patience -- will be required.
In the rotation: The Blue Jays can be patient now
It feels like the rotation has been settled … but it also felt excessive when Toronto had eight MLB-caliber starters midway through camp last season, and look at how that played out.

Considering that Taira pitched once a week in Japan, he’ll require some workload management, particularly early in the season. The Blue Jays could manage this with a swingman -- hello, Spencer Miles -- but they could also choose to open with a six-man rotation. That would leave the door open to the short-term market for veteran starters, including Kevin Gausman, Michael Soroka, Tyler Mahle, Foster Griffin, Shota Imanaga and others.

Regardless, each idea will demand a great deal from the Blue Jays’ bullpen, and make a couple of multi-inning relievers particularly valuable. Toronto is still fully involved in the bullpen market -- shopping at a higher tier than many expected going into the offseason -- but exactly how Taira is handled will be the No. 1 factor in all of this. Ideally, the Blue Jays have some extreme pitching flexibility by choice in 2027, not by necessity like they were forced to in ‘26.
items.titleZh: 大笔签约已定，但多伦多蓝鸟仍需大胆运作
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟签下日本右投平良海马，但79胜的阵容仍需在进攻端进行大幅度补强。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯——终于，是时候探讨接下来的动作了。
随着以5年8000万美元的合同签下日本右投 Kaima Taira，多伦多蓝鸟正式拉开了休赛期阵容重组的序幕。这位新援立刻成为了球队名单中最受关注的球员，但这仅仅是个开始。
球队打出79胜83负的战绩且拥有大联盟最糟糕的进攻，这显然不是小修小补能解决的。球队需要的是彻底改造，包括对蓝鸟的打线进行多次升级。Kaima Taira 的加盟让先发轮值有机会变得真正顶尖，但在未来的日子和月份里，蓝鸟仍有一些工作要做。
这是在与 Kaima Taira 达成协议24小时后的现状：
在打线方面：是时候展现魄力了
随着每一天过去，Seiya Suzuki 看起来越来越适合这支球队。有时，我们不需要把休赛期搞得过于复杂。
一个月前 Seiya Suzuki 合适，昨天合适，今天依然合适。这可以说是自蓝鸟六年前签下 George Springer 以来最契合的一笔引援，坦白说，这份合同最终看起来可能会非常相似（只是理想情况下不会延伸到第六个赛季）。
在极度渴望长打火力且右外野角落明显有空缺的情况下，蓝鸟与 Seiya Suzuki 的结合水到渠成，而他只需要金钱成本。交易市场也将提供大量的机会——而且这一局势可能会根据下一份劳资协议而改变——但通过 Seiya Suzuki，蓝鸟有机会在不透支已展现出明显进步的小联盟农场体系的情况下，显著提升他们的进攻火力。
自从从日本的 Hiroshima Carp 加盟以来，Seiya Suzuki 在小熊的五个赛季表现得相当稳定。他职业生涯打击率为.269，上垒率为.351，OPS为.823，每个赛季都有能力打出25支以上本垒打。你几乎可以把这看作是 Springer 在25和26赛季之间的一个折中点，并预计 Seiya Suzuki 将在打线中担任第二棒到第四棒。
Jazz Chisholm Jr. 当然也符合“大胆”的定义。他的薪资肯定会低于 Seiya Suzuki 的合同，但如果你像蓝鸟一样在追求进攻上限和跑垒潜力，很多重大利好都指向 Jazz Chisholm。Ernie Clement 明天依然可以去竞选首相，因此在二垒位置上的任何变动都会立即引发关注，但 Clement 出色的运动能力依然能让他在打线中占据常规位置。

然而，讨论到这里便接近了尾声。像 Seiya Suzuki、Jazz Chisholm、Randy Arozarena 和 Brandon Lowe 这样的打者，将代表他们所加盟的几乎任何球队在进攻端得到明显升级。然而，在其之下的打者梯队，则将我们带到了收益递减的点。例如，B级打者对 Clement 或 Nathan Lukes 来说究竟能算多大程度的升级，而为这种边际升级冒险值得花这些钱吗？Gleyber Torres 就是一个很好的例子，他是一名优秀的球员，会在某个地方找到自己的角色，但在多伦多，“提升”的潜力似乎并不存在。
蓝鸟在这里需要追逐上限和天花板，就像他们在轮值中对 Kaima Taira 做的那样。如果他们无法在当前的打者梯队中找到这一点，将重心转向交易市场——或许再加上一点耐心——将是必不可少的。
在先发轮值方面：蓝鸟现在可以保持耐心了
感觉轮值已经确定了……但上赛季中期多伦多拥有八名大联盟级别的先发投手时，也曾让人觉得过剩，看看结果如何就知道了。
考虑到 Kaima Taira 在日本是一周投一场，他需要进行一些工作量的管理，尤其是在赛季初期。蓝鸟可以通过一名摇摆人来管理这一点——比如 Spencer Miles ——但他们也可以选择以六人轮值开局。这将为短期老将先发投手市场敞开大门，包括 Kevin Gausman、Michael Soroka、Tyler Mahle、Foster Griffin、Shota Imanaga 等人。
无论如何，每一个想法都将对蓝鸟的牛棚提出巨大的要求，并使几位能投多局的后援投手变得格外有价值。多伦多目前仍全方位参与牛棚市场的竞争——其采购的档次高于许多人在休赛期开始前的预期——但具体如何使用 Kaima Taira 将是这一切头号决定因素。理想情况下，蓝鸟在2027年可以通过自主选择来获得极端的投手调度灵活性，而不是像26赛季那样被迫为之。

items.titleEn: Here's what to know about Kaima Taira and how the Blue Jays could utilize him
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The most interesting pitcher on the free-agent market just became the most interesting man on the Toronto Blue Jays.
Kaima Taira, all 5-foot-8, 220 pounds of him, is a pitching anomaly.

The Blue Jays agreed to terms on a five-year, $80 million deal with the Japanese right-hander Tuesday, a source told MLB.com. The deal, which the club has not yet announced, includes an opt-out after the 2029 season. Pitchers coming over from Japan’s NPB always have a layer of intrigue from the very beginning, given the move overseas between leagues, but Taira’s unique build and fascinating arsenal add a completely different dimension to this move.

This is a bold move by the Blue Jays, chasing the unknown upside of Taira instead of settling for sturdy, reliable innings on a short-term veteran deal. This tracks with the Blue Jays’ recent shift in philosophy, though, leaning towards starters like Dylan Cease and José Soriano instead of the safer options they’d been drawn to in the past, like Chris Bassitt or José Berríos. They’re going younger, too, grabbing a 27-year-old Taira for his prime years instead of hoping a pitcher in their mid-30s can keep it on the tracks.
This is what you need to know:
Height doesn’t measure … everything

Taira’s height will make plenty of headlines this week and heading into next season, but that’s just one data point. The more important numbers are Taira’s extension and release point, which essentially means: How far down the mound does Taira release the baseball, and how high off the ground?

Our David Adler wrote this excellent, timely breakdown of Taira’s delivery and pitch mix this week, which captures that well. The key word to remember with Taira is “explosiveness,” and it’s all about his lower body.

Taira drives hard down the mound, which sets him up to release his pitch 6.8 feet in front of the rubber. That’s closer to home plate than the MLB average (6.5 feet from the rubber), meaning that Taira makes up for his lack of height and wingspan by driving his body further down the mound. It’s common to see Japanese pitchers make great use of their lower body in their deliveries, but Taira’s seems so much more powerful than most. It’s an aggressive move, built to launch Taira towards the plate.

By the time Taira releases his pitch, though, that release point is just 4.94 feet off the ground on fastballs, which would have been tied with Chris Sale for the second-lowest in MLB last season (behind only Joe Ryan). What an incredible contrast with Trey Yesavage, who at 7.06 feet, had the highest release point among qualified starters last season. Good luck facing those two on back-to-back nights, especially if the submariner Tyler Rogers gets involved out of the bullpen.

Taira’s arsenal runs deep, too. That four-seam fastball is supported by seven other unique pitches, including his cutter, two-seamer, changeup, splitter, slider, sweeper and curveball. Perhaps the Blue Jays tighten that up or push Taira to lean into one of those pitches more often, but that’s a fun project for the pitching staff when camp opens.

What all of this adds up to is an extremely unique look. Taira is a cannonball on the mound, and when his low release point is paired with upper-90s heat, it’s a look few MLB hitters will be comfortable with, especially in Taira’s first trip around the league.
Projecting the role … and the rotation

This rotation is set with Cease, Taira, Soriano, Yesavage and one of Cody Ponce or Spencer Miles. More depth will come, too, but the Blue Jays have to feel awfully confident in the upside of this group.

Managing Taira’s workload will be a major variable, though. Starters typically throw once per week in Japan, and while he’ll adapt to the Major League schedule, it’s something the Blue Jays will need to monitor. This could actually end up working naturally into their planning, at least in the early days of the season.

Cease and Soriano both pitched big innings in 2026, Cease’s ending with some shoulder inflammation. Yesavage missed time, Ponce missed nearly the entire season with a knee injury and Miles, the Rule 5 wonder, had a huge uptick in workload to reach 95 2/3 innings. Add in Taira, and across the board, we’re looking at a pitching staff that could benefit from additional off-days or the odd “sixth starter” early in the season.

We’ve also seen Taira succeed in high-leverage bullpen roles in Japan, both earlier in his career and while his arm health was managed. He’s coming to Toronto to start, though, and this might already be the most intriguing move we see all winter.
items.titleZh: 了解Kaima Taira以及多伦多蓝鸟如何使用他
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟以5年8000万美元签下日本右投Kaima Taira，他的独特投球风格备受关注。
bodyZh: 多伦多——自由球员市场上最有趣的投手，刚刚成为了多伦多蓝鸟队最有趣的人。
身高5尺8寸、体重220磅的Kaima Taira，是一个投球层面的特例。
据MLB.com消息源透露，多伦多蓝鸟周二与这位日本右投达成了一份为期5年、价值8000万美元的协议。这笔签约尚未由俱乐部正式宣布，其中包含2029赛季结束后的跳出条款。从日本NPB转战大联盟的投手从一开始总是自带一层神秘感，但Taira独特的身材和令人着迷的球路组合，为这次转会增添了完全不同的维度。

对于多伦多蓝鸟来说，这是一个大胆的举动，他们追逐的是Taira未知的发展上限，而不是用短期老将合同去换取稳健可靠的投球局数。不过，这也符合多伦多蓝鸟近期的理念转变，他们更倾向于像Dylan Cease和José Soriano这样的先发投手，而不是过去那种他们更青睐的保守选项，比如Chris Bassitt或José Berríos。他们也在走向年轻化，拿下正值巅峰期的27岁Taira，而不是指望一个三十岁中段的投手能维持状态。
以下是你需要了解的内容：
身高无法衡量……一切
本周以及进入下赛季时，Taira的身高将占据大量头条新闻，但这只是一个数据点。更重要的数据是Taira的延伸距离（extension）和出手点，这基本上意味着：Taira在投手板前方多远处出手投球，以及距离地面有多高？
我们的David Adler本周撰写了一篇极好且及时的文章，详细分析了Taira的投球动作和球路组合，非常精准地捕捉到了这一点。关于Taira需要记住的关键词是“爆发力”，这完全取决于他的下半身。
Taira在投手板上的发力非常猛烈，这使得他的出手点在投手板前方6.8英尺处。这比大联盟平均水平（距离投手板6.5英尺）更接近本垒板，这意味着Taira通过身体在投手板前方的充分前压，弥补了身高和臂展的不足。我们经常看到日本投手在投球时极好地利用下半身，但Taira的下半身力量似乎比大多数人都要强得多。这是一个极具侵略性的动作，旨在将Taira整个人“发射”向本垒板。
不过，当Taira出手投球时，他投直球的出手点距离地面仅有4.94英尺，在上赛季的大联盟中与Chris Sale并列第二低（仅次于Joe Ryan）。这与Trey Yesavage形成了不可思议的对比，后者身高带来的出手点高达7.06英尺，在上赛季符合投球局数资格的先发投手当中是最高的。连续两个晚上面对这两人祝你好运，尤其是如果牛棚里还有低手投球的Tyler Rogers登场的话。
Taira的球路非常丰富。他的四缝线直球得到了其他七种独特球路的支撑，包括卡特球、二缝线直球、变速球、指叉球、滑球、横扫滑球和曲球。也许蓝鸟队会精简这些球路，或者促使Taira更频繁地依赖其中某几种球路，但这将是春训开始时教练组一项有趣的课题。
所有这一切加在一起，造就了一种极其独特的视觉效果。Taira就像是投手丘上的一颗炮弹，当他低出手点与逼近100英里的球速相结合时，这种视觉效果是极少有大联盟打者会感到适应的，尤其是在Taira首次对阵联盟各队的时候。
展望角色……以及先发轮换
目前的先发轮换已经确定，包括Cease、Taira、Soriano、Yesavage，以及Cody Ponce或Spencer Miles中的一人。未来还会有更多的深度补强，但多伦多蓝鸟队对这批球员的发展上限必须感到无比自信。
不过，管理Taira的工作负荷将是一个主要的变数。在日本，先发投手通常一周投一场比赛，虽然他会适应大联盟的赛程，但这仍是多伦多蓝鸟需要监控的事情。这实际上可能最终会自然地融入他们的规划中，至少在赛季初期是这样。
Cease和Soriano在2026年都投了大量的局数，Cease的赛季以肩膀发炎告终。Yesavage缺席了一段时间，Ponce因膝伤几乎缺席了整个赛季，而作为规则五选秀奇迹的Miles则经历了巨大的工作负荷飙升，投满了95.2局。再加上Taira，全面来看，这支投手教练组可能会从赛季初期的额外休息日或偶尔的“第六先发”中受益。
我们也曾见证过Taira在日本的高压牛棚角色中取得成功，无论是在其职业生涯早期还是在手臂健康受到控制的时期。不过，他来到多伦多是为了担任先发，这可能已经是我们整个冬天见过的最引人注目的转会操作了。

items.titleEn: Why the 2026 rookie class might have been the best ever
bodyEn: The 2026 Major League season was, by a lot of measures, the “Year of the Rookie.” Giving this rookie class a 360-degree examination, it’s pretty clear this was the best cumulative rookie season ever. Does that mean it will go down as the greatest rookie class of all time?
Here are a number of reasons why the answer to that question should be yes.
1. The clear leader in WAR

MLB.com's Andrew Simon did a terrific job of breaking down the best rookie classes since the Rookie of the Year Award was first given out in 1947. He used FanGraphs’ Wins Above Replacement (WAR) and the Class of 2026 beat all rookie groups in total fWAR (128.6) and percentage of all WAR accrued in Major League Baseball for the year (12.9). This season also saw the most rookies with at least 2 WAR (31).

To go a step further, the 2026 rookie class had more players with 4.0 WAR or more (6) than any other group, edging the 2022 class by one player. Taking a look at MLB Pipeline colleague Jim Callis’ oft-debated long-term rookie rankings through a WAR lens, you can see just how dominant the 2026 class was. His top 40 from this year accrued 81.3 total WAR. That’s a whopping 54.8 more than his 2025 list.
2. PPI having huge impact

Teams did not shy away from putting rookies on their Opening Day rosters to give them a chance of earning an extra Draft pick as the Prospect Promotion Incentive seems to be having its desired impact.

Three PPI picks will be awarded based on teams putting rookies on Opening Day rosters. The Tigers and Reds each get one thanks to Kevin McGonigle and Sal Stewart winning Rookie of the Year honors. The Guardians also get one because Parker Messick finished third in Cy Young Award voting. That’s the most picks awarded since the new system was added in 2022.

There were a record 20 Top 100 prospects on Opening Day rosters, a number that doesn’t include Pirates phenom Konnor Griffin, who did accrue enough service time to qualify for a PPI pick in the future. He and the three above were part of a record 15 prospects who qualified for the extra Draft selection, including five of the six Rookie of the Year finalists. If any of them finish in the top three in MVP or Cy Young voting before they reach arbitration (in 2027 or 2028), they’ll earn their organization that extra pick. It’s an impressive list:

Blue Jays: Trey YesavageCardinals: JJ WetherholtGuardians: Chase DeLauterMarlins: Owen CaissieMets: Carson Benge, Nolan McLeanOrioles: Samuel Basallo, Dylan BeaversPhillies: Justin CrawfordPirates: Konnor Griffin, Bubba ChandlerRoyals: Carter Jensen
McGonigle, Wetherholt, Benge and Jensen finished top four among all rookies in WAR; DeLauter was sixth. Messick and McLean finished first and third in WAR among rookie pitchers.
3. All-Stars and awards aplenty

The push to get players on Opening Day rosters because of the PPI picks might have had an impact on how many rookies made the All-Star Game in Philadelphia in July. There were seven at the Midsummer Classic this year, the most since eight rookies dotted the rosters in 2001 (a banner year with two legends starting as rookies in Hall of Famer Ichiro Suzuki and likely future Hall of Famer Albert Pujols).

All-Star nods weren’t the only recognition this class got. This marked just the third time two rookies earned Silver Slugger Awards. McGonigle and DeLauter were the winners this year, the first time since the aforementioned Ichiro and Pujols won. The only other time it happened was in 1987 (Matt Nokes, Benito Santiago).

While he didn’t win the Cy Young (though finishing third did get that PPI pick for the Guardians), Messick is only the sixth rookie to finish in the top three in voting for the award. It’s a pretty good list he joins:
2024 Paul Skenes, 3rd NL2013 José Fernández, 3rd NL1984 Dwight Gooden, 2nd NL1981 Fernando Valenzuela, 1st NL1976 Mark Fidrych, 2nd AL
4. Rookies staying (surprisingly) healthy

Several rookies this year who added to the depth and quality of the class overcame injuries to make major contributions. DeLauter had never played more than 60 games in the Minors since being a first-round pick in 2022 before logging 133 regular-season games for Cleveland this year, which helped him earn both that Silver Slugger Award and Rookie of the Year votes.

Logan Henderson hadn’t thrown more than 81 1/3 innings in any of his three full Minor League seasons before helping the Brewers win the World Series this year. He ended up getting ROY votes as well and finished with 2.4 fWAR.

Down the list a little further is a guy like Connor Prielipp of the Twins. He threw 30 innings total over his first two years of pro ball before managing to get through 82 2/3 IP in 2025. This year he amassed 125 2/3 in the big league rotation which resulted in 2.0 WAR.
5. Impact players from Japan

Kazuma Okamoto and Munetaka Murakami don’t qualify for PPI consideration as foreign professionals who signed to come over from Japan for the 2026 season. But both did receive AL Rookie of the Year votes while accruing a combined 5.9 WAR (Okamoto had 3.0 WAR for the Blue Jays; Murakami 2.9 for the White Sox). Add in Foster Griffin, who figured things out over three years pitching for the Yomiuri Giants before coming back and becoming a surprising rookie All-Star with the Nationals (joining Murakami among that rookie All-Star set), before getting traded to Cleveland for its playoff run. Sure, you don’t see many 30-year old official rookies, but Griffin finished fourth among all rookie pitchers with his 2.6 WAR.
6. Contributions from everywhere

Impact from Top 100 guys didn’t stop with the influx of that talent on Opening Day rosters. A grand total of 53 Top 100 prospects played in the big leagues this past season, the second-highest total since we started putting out the list of 100 in 2012. Along with the elite-level prospects, there was a substantial quality of non-top 100 guys who arguably performed above expectations. This year’s long-term rookie rankings included eight players who weren’t on the preseason Top 100 list, and that group accrued 17.3 bWAR (Baseball-Reference’s version of the stat). That accounted for 21 percent of the WAR on the top 40 rookies listed in the story, a sign that this class has quality and quantity.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
7. There’s ceiling that’s yet to be reached

We obviously won’t know just how good this class is career-wise for some time, but as impressive as the collective presence was in year one, there are reasons to be even more bullish about what’s to come. Keep in mind that Konnor Griffin, who was the No. 1 prospect in baseball at the start of the season, only played 80 games because of injury in 2026. When he was healthy, he looked every bit like the future superstar he’s been projected to be, and having him join his class for full seasons in the future will be exciting.

And not every rookie had a great season, but there’s reason to believe that top 10 overall prospects like Samuel Basallo of the Orioles and Colt Emerson of the Mariners will figure things out after combining for just 0.5 fWAR in 2026. On the mound, both Bubba Chandler (No. 11 on the preseason Top 100, 2.0 WAR) and Trey Yesavage (No. 12, 1.3) have huge upsides they haven’t reached ... yet.
items.titleZh: 为什么说2026届新秀可能是历史最佳
items.summaryZh: 从WAR值、PPI政策、全明星表现到伤病克服，2026赛季的新秀集体爆发，创造了多项历史纪录，堪称史上最佳新秀赛季。
bodyZh: 从许多指标来看，2026年的大联盟赛季都可以被称为“新秀之年”。全面审视这届新秀，很明显这是历史上累积表现最好的新秀赛季。但这是否意味着它将作为历史最伟大的一届新秀阵容载入史册？
以下是支持这一结论的诸多理由。
1. 在WAR值上占据绝对领先地位
MLB.com的Andrew Simon出色地梳理了自1947年设立年度最佳新秀奖以来最优秀的新秀阵容。他使用了FanGraphs的胜利贡献值（WAR），而2026届新秀在总fWAR（128.6）以及当年大联盟所有WAR中所占比例（12.9%）上，击败了所有其他新秀群体。本赛季还诞生了最多WAR至少达到2的新秀人数（31人）。
更进一步来看，2026届新秀中WAR达到4.0或以上的球员人数（6人）比任何其他群体都多，比2022届多出一人。通过WAR的视角来看看MLB Pipeline同事Jim Callis经常引发讨论的长期新秀排名，你可以发现2026届新秀是多么具有统治力。他今年评选的前40名球员共计贡献了81.3的的总WAR。这比他2025年的榜单高出惊人的54.8。
2. PPI（潜力新秀促进奖）产生巨大影响
各支球队并没有吝啬于将新秀放入揭幕战大名单中，以期让他们有机会赢得额外的选秀权，因为潜力新秀促进奖（PPI）似乎正发挥着预期的作用。
根据球队将新秀放入揭幕战大名单的情况，将颁发三个PPI选秀权。底特律老虎和辛辛那提红人由于Kevin McGonigle和Sal Stewart赢得最佳新秀荣誉而各得一个。克利夫兰守护者也获得一个，因为Parker Messick在赛扬奖投票中名列第三。这是自2022年引入该新系统以来颁发选秀权最多的一次。

揭幕战大名单上有创纪录的20名百大潜力新秀，这个数字还不包括匹兹堡海盗的天才球员Konnor Griffin，他确实积累了足够的球员工龄，有资格在未来获得PPI选秀权。他和上述三人都是创纪录的15名有资格获得额外选秀权的潜力新秀的一部分，其中包括六名最佳新秀最终候选人中的五人。如果他们在到达薪资仲裁之前（在2027年或2028年）在MVP或赛扬奖投票中名列前三，他们将为各自的组织赢得额外的选秀权。这是一个令人印象深刻的名单：

多伦多蓝鸟：Trey Yesavage；圣路易斯红雀：JJ Wetherholt；克利夫兰守护者：Chase DeLauter；迈阿密马林鱼：Owen Caissie；纽约大都会：Carson Benge, Nolan McLean；巴尔的摩金莺：Samuel Basallo, Dylan Beavers；费城费城人：Justin Crawford；匹兹堡海盗：Konnor Griffin, Bubba Chandler；堪萨斯城皇家：Carter Jensen
McGonigle、Wetherholt、Benge和Jensen在所有新秀的WAR中名列前四；DeLauter名列第六。Messick和McLean在所有新秀投手的WAR中分别名列第一和第三。
3. 全明星和奖项拿到手软
因为PPI选秀权而将球员选入揭幕战大名单的推动力，可能对7月在费城举行的全明星赛中有多少新秀入选产生了影响。今年有七名新秀参加了仲夏经典赛，这是自2001年有八名新秀入选以来的最高纪录（那是一个辉煌的年份，两位传奇球星以新秀身份首发，分别是名人堂成员铃木一朗以及未来很可能入选名人堂的Albert Pujols）。
全明星的认可并不是这届新秀获得的唯一肯定。这是历史上第三次有两名新秀获得银棒奖。McGonigle和DeLauter是今年的得奖者，这是自前面提到的铃木一朗和Albert Pujols获奖以来首次出现。唯一另一次发生是在1987年（Matt Nokes、Benito Santiago）。
虽然他没有赢得赛扬奖（尽管获得第三名确实为守护者队赢得了那个PPI选秀权），但Messick是第六位在该奖项投票中进入前三名的新秀。他加入了一个非常出色的名单：
2024年 Paul Skenes，国家联盟第3；2013年 José Fernández，国家联盟第3；1984年 Dwight Gooden，国家联盟第2；1981年 Fernando Valenzuela，国家联盟第1；1976年 Mark Fidrych，美国联盟第2
4. 新秀们（出人意料地）保持健康
今年几位增加了该届新秀深度和质量的新秀克服了伤病，做出了重大贡献。自2022年成为首轮新秀以来，DeLauter在小联盟中从未打过超过60场比赛，但在今年为克利夫兰出战了133场常规赛，这帮助他赢得了银棒奖和最佳新秀的选票。
Logan Henderson在他三个完整的小联盟赛季中，没有任何一个赛季投球超过81.3局，但在今年帮助酿酒人赢得世界大赛之前，他发挥了重要作用。他最终也获得了年度最佳新秀选票，并以2.4的fWAR收官。
稍微往下看名单，还有像双城的Connor Prielipp这样的人。他在职业生涯的前两年总共投了30局，随后在2025年设法完成了82.3局。今年他在大联盟先发轮值中累计投了125.3局，这带来了2.0的WAR。
5. 来自日本的实力球员

作为以海外职业球员身份签约、为2026赛季从日本转战大联盟的冈本和真（Kazuma Okamoto）和村上宗隆（Munetaka Murakami）不符合PPI的考量资格。但两人都获得了美国联盟最佳新秀的选票，同时合计贡献了5.9的WAR（冈本和真为蓝鸟贡献了3.0的WAR；村上宗隆为白袜贡献了2.9的WAR）。再加上Foster Griffin，他在为读卖巨人队投球三年并理清头绪后归来，成为国民队令人惊异的新秀全明星（与村上宗隆一同跻身新秀全明星阵容），随后在季后赛冲刺阶段被交易到克利夫兰。当然，你不会经常看到30岁官方身份的新秀，但Griffin凭借其2.6的WAR在所有新秀投手排在第四位。
6. 来自各方各面的贡献

百大球星带来的影响力并未止步于揭幕战大名单中这批天赋球员的涌入。过去这个赛季，总共有53名百大潜力新秀在大联盟出赛，这是自2012年我们开始发布100人名单以来的第二高总数。除了精英级别的潜力新秀外，还有大量非百大榜单上的球员，他们的表现可以说是超出了预期。今年长期新秀排名中包含了八位季前百大榜单上没有的球员，这群球员积累了17.3的bWAR（Baseball-Reference版本的统计数据）。这占了报道中前40名新秀所产生WAR的21%，这表明这届新秀既有质量又有数量。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 新闻简报
7. 尚未触及的天花板
从职业生涯的角度来看，我们显然还需要一段时间才能知道这届新秀到底有多优秀，但正如第一年集体展现的实力那样令人印象深刻，我们有理由对未来的发展更加看好。请记住，在赛季开始时作为大联盟头号潜力新秀的Konnor Griffin，在2026年因伤只打了80场比赛。当他保持健康时，他完全展现出了人们所预期未来巨星的风采，未来看到他与同届球员一起完整征战赛季将会令人兴奋。
并非每一位新秀都有一个伟大的赛季，但有理由相信，像金莺队的Samuel Basallo和水手队的Colt Emerson这样综合排名前十的潜力新秀，在2026年合计仅贡献0.5的fWAR之后，会逐渐适应并打出名堂。在投手方面，Bubba Chandler（季前百大排名第11位，2.0 WAR）和Trey Yesavage（第12位，1.3 WAR）都拥有他们尚未完全兑现的巨大上限……拭目以待。

items.titleEn: Where does Blue Jays' rotation stand before potential additions?
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson's Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- Remember when the Blue Jays brought back Max Scherzer last spring, in early March? It felt absurd.
How many pitchers could one team really need? Well, the answer is always painful, and that answer is always: More of them.

At the time, the Blue Jays could have gone eight deep with Major League starters alone. We didn’t yet know -- at least publicly -- how serious Shane Bieber’s elbow and forearm issue would be to start the season. There was still hope, too, that Trey Yesavage would be ready around Opening Day, and we didn’t expect Cody Ponce to injure his right knee just minutes into his Blue Jays debut. Scherzer’s return felt like another layer of extreme excess, but now it acts as a lesson.

After Tarik Skubal and the Mets reportedly agreed to terms on a massive nine-year, $450 million deal Sunday night, all eyes will be on the pitching market this week, waiting for the wave of moves to follow. The next tier of that market is led by Freddy Peralta, who’s a strong fit for the Blue Jays. The best way to build depth is to add a star, bumping everyone else down one rung, but regardless of how the Blue Jays attack this, they’ll need to build a rotation that’s strong well beyond the big league roster. This is how it looks right now:
The starting five…ish:
Dylan Cease, Yesavage and José Soriano form a fine trio atop this rotation, and if the Blue Jays can land another big name, that could bump this group into the elite tier across MLB.

For the time being, let’s consider one spot in this rotation to be “TBD," given the near certainty that the Blue Jays address this group with at least one more veteran arm. Whether it’s Peralta or something closer to the middle tier, where old friend Kevin Gausman sits, someone is joining this rotation.

That brings us to the No. 5 role, and for now, it’s best to view that as a timeshare between Ponce and Spencer Miles. Remember, only two pitchers threw more than 100 innings for the Blue Jays in 2026: Cease and Gausman. Miles, the Rule 5 Draft wonder, is coming off 95 2/3 innings in what was a serious uptick for him. Ponce, coming off his knee surgery, barely pitched at all in '26. We can’t call it a “zero” given that he threw as he rehabbed, but neither of these pitchers are slated for 180 innings.
Miles, as the new kid on the block, is the big variable here.

“We’re going to prepare him to be able to do something in a similar fashion to what he just did,” general manager Ross Atkins said. “It may look differently. He did an incredible job managing a workload, managing the highest level of competition very, very well and with a lot being asked of him switching into different roles. I think what we’ll look to do is have less volatility and less change to what he’s doing.”

If each can get to 120 innings, the Blue Jays could consider anything on top of that a bonus. Pieced together, that’s enough to cover one rotation spot with some bulk innings on the side, allowing the Blue Jays to manage each of their buildups without hamstringing the rotation.
Going deeper: Who’s 6th, 7th and 8th in line?

Spencer Arrighetti has been the forgotten man here after he struggled down the stretch following his trade from the Astros, but he’s a crucial piece. With Minor League options remaining and the ability to work as a true starter -- not just another “bulk guy” -- he’s a lock to make some starts for this team in 2027. That’s what the Blue Jays lacked when injuries hit last season -- a true starter with options.

A healthy Jake Bloss will be a major factor, too, and still has the upside to force his way into this picture at some point in 2027. Nolan Perry (the Blue Jays’ No. 2 prospect) represents the next wave after he was added to the roster alongside Daniel Guerra (No. 15) last week, but the Blue Jays want to turn to prospects because they’re undeniable, not out of necessity.

By later in the season, Tommy John rehabs could leave José Berríos and Bowden Francis as options, along with versatile arms on the fringes of this roster like Chad Dallas (No. 22), Lazaro Estrada, Josh Stephan and John Klein (No. 29).

That’s digging far deeper than the Blue Jays hope to, though, and they’ll need to ensure that their sixth-to-eighth options are capable of winning games, not just surviving them. Big runs at big names will dominate the coming weeks, but amid all these headlines, the Blue Jays still feel a piece or two away from living comfortably.
items.titleZh: 潜在补强前多伦多蓝鸟先发轮值现状
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟在潜在补强前正审视现有先发轮值深度与人选安排。
bodyZh: 本文摘自 Keegan Matheson 的 Blue Jays Beat 通讯。若要阅读完整通讯请点击此处。并可订阅以定期在收件箱中接收。
多伦多 -- 还记得去年春训伊始的 3 月上旬多伦多蓝鸟重新签下 Max Scherzer 的时候吗？这感觉荒谬极了。
一支球队到底能需要多少名投手？好吧，答案总是痛苦的，而这个答案永远是：需要更多。

当时，单单算上大联盟先发投手，多伦多蓝鸟的深度就可以达到八人。我们当时还不知道——至少在公开场合不知道——Shane Bieber 的手肘和前臂问题在赛季初会有多严重。人们当时还怀有希望，认为 Trey Yesavage 能在揭幕战前后准备好，而且我们也没有料到 Cody Ponce 在多伦多蓝鸟首秀仅仅几分钟后就伤了右膝。Max Scherzer 的回归感觉像是另一种极端的冗余，但现在它成了一个教训。

据报道，Tarik Skubal 与纽约大都会于周日晚间达成了一份为期 9 年、价值 4.5 亿美元的巨额合同后，本周所有目光都将聚焦于投手市场，等待随之而来的交易浪潮。该市场的下一梯队由 Freddy Peralta 领衔，他是多伦多蓝鸟的强力人选。建立深度的最好方法是增加一名球星，将其他人往下挤一个顺位，但无论多伦多蓝鸟如何着手，他们都需要建立一个实力远超大联盟现役名单的轮值。目前的情况如下：
前五号先发……左右：
Dylan Cease、Yesavage 和 José Soriano 构成了这个轮值顶端的优秀三人组，如果多伦多蓝鸟能够再签下一位大牌球星，这支组合可能会跻身整个美国职业棒球大联盟的精英行列。
目前，考虑到多伦多蓝鸟几乎确定会再引进至少一名老将投手，我们可以将轮值中的一个位置视为“待定”。无论是 Peralta 还是接近中游梯队的球员（例如老熟人 Kevin Gausman），都会有人加入这个轮值。

这就带出了五号先发角色，就目前而言，最好将其视为 Ponce 和 Spencer Miles 之间的时间分享。请记住，在 2026 赛季中，只有两名投手为多伦多蓝鸟投球超过 100 局：Cease 和 Gausman。规则五选秀的奇迹 Miles 在经历了一次大幅度提升后，投了 95.2 局。刚刚做完膝盖手术的 Ponce 在 2026 赛季几乎没有投球。我们不能称之为“零”，因为他在复健期间投过球，但这两名投手都不在 180 局的计划中。
Miles 作为新面孔，是这里的最大变数。
“我们将为他做好准备，让他能够以类似于他刚刚完成的方式做一些事情，”总经理 Ross Atkins 表示。“它看起来可能会有所不同。他在管理工作量、管理最高水平的竞争方面做得非常出色，而且在转换到不同角色时被委以重任。我认为我们要寻找的是减少波动，减少对他在做的事情的改变。”
如果每个人都能投到 120 局，多伦多蓝鸟可以将此之上的任何表现视为额外红利。拼凑起来，这足以覆盖一个轮值位置，并在旁边提供一些大局数的投球，让多伦多蓝鸟能够在不削弱轮值的情况下管理每个人的成长。
更深入来看：排在第 6、7、8 位的都是谁？
Spencer Arrighetti 在从休斯敦太空人被交易后于赛季末段陷入挣扎，在此之后他成了被遗忘的人，但他是一个关键棋子。由于还保有小联盟下放权，且能够胜任真正的先发投手——而不仅仅是另一个“吃局数的人”——他注定会在 2027 赛季为这支球队先发几场。这正是多伦多蓝鸟在上赛季遭遇伤病时所缺乏的——一个拥有下放权的真正先发投手。
健康的 Jake Bloss 也将是一个重要因素，并且仍然拥有在 2027 赛季某个时刻强行进入这一画面的上限。Nolan Perry（多伦多蓝鸟排名第 2 的潜力新秀）在上周与 Daniel Guerra（第 15 名）一同被加入名单后，代表了下一代新秀浪潮，但多伦多蓝鸟希望起用潜力新秀是因为他们不可忽视，而不是出于必要性。
到了赛季后期，Tommy John 手术后的复健可能会让 José Berríos 和 Bowden Francis 成为选项，此外还有处于这份名单边缘的多面手投手，例如 Chad Dallas（第 22 名）、Lazaro Estrada、Josh Stephan 和 John Klein（第 29 名）。
不过，这比多伦多蓝鸟希望的挖掘要深得多，他们需要确保其第六到第八号选项有能力赢得比赛，而不仅仅是在比赛中苦苦支撑。对大牌球星的疯狂追逐将主导接下来的几周，但在所有这些头条新闻中，多伦多蓝鸟仍然觉得距离安稳还有一两个拼图的差距。

items.titleEn: The signature HR swing of the Blue Jays' best slugger
bodyEn: For a Blue Jays team that finished dead last in the Majors in home runs in 2026 … thank goodness they at least had Kazuma Okamoto.

In his first season in the Majors, Okamoto was really the only Jays hitter who provided any sort of thump. He hit 33 of Toronto's 152 homers, 22% of the team's total. The only hitters who accounted for a higher share of their team's home runs were Junior Caminero for the Rays (25%), Kyle Schwarber for the Phillies (25%) and Hunter Goodman for the Rockies (23%).

Okamoto's home run total was more than double any other Blue Jays hitter -- George Springer was next with 15. It was nearly quadruple the nine home runs that Vladimir Guerrero Jr. managed in his power outage of a season.
And over the course of the season, an Okamoto home run signature emerged: the down-and-in home run.
Okamoto loves to go golfing. And he was the best right-handed golfer in the league last season.
Eleven of Okamoto's 33 home runs, a full third of his season total, came against pitches in the lower, inner part of the strike zone. That was the most of any righty slugger.
Most HR by RHB vs. down-and-in pitches in 2026
Kazuma Okamoto: 11
Hunter Goodman / Andy Pages / Zack Gelof: 7
Pete Alonso / Sal Stewart / Nolan Arenado / Salvador Perez / Ezequiel Duran: 6

Okamoto was, stylistically, something like the righty version of Yordan Alvarez. The American League MVP hit 12 of his 42 home runs off down-and-in pitches, creating a similar gap over the next-closest left-handed hitters (CJ Abrams, Matt Olson, Gunnar Henderson and Trent Grisham) to Okamoto's over his fellow right-handed hitters.

There's nothing more majestic than a low-ball hitter's home run swing, and Okamoto's is a beauty when he connects. He even steepened his swing path over the course of the season -- all the better to golf home runs with.
Okamoto's swing tilt by month(More tilt = bigger uppercut)
April -- 29°
June -- 32°
July -- 33°
Sept. -- 33°

At the end of the year, Okamoto's swing was, on average, four degrees steeper than it was at the start. That makes sense for the type of power hitting he was doing. Turning on lower pitches on the inner part of the plate requires a steeper swing path.

There's really only one place for those down-and-in homers to go: pulled out to left field, and deep. The only one of Okamoto's down-and-in homers that went the other way was his first MLB homer on Opening Weekend -- a flatter, inside-out swing that came a few weeks before Okamoto moved back in the batter's box and gave himself more time to get the barrel out front and turn on pitches.
After that change, it was a ton of pulled air balls. That became an Okamoto specialty.

Pulling the ball in the air is the most direct path to home runs, and 27% of Okamoto's batted balls in his first season in Toronto were pulled in the air. That put him in the 90th percentile of MLB sluggers, and ranked 18th of the 179 hitters with at least 300 batted balls.

It was a great "rookie" showing for the longtime Yomiuri Giants star, and a repeat power performance from Okamoto next season would go a long way toward helping the Blue Jays get back to the playoffs.

So will he do it again in 2027? The projections at least think he'll be close. FanGraphs' Depth Charts projects Okamoto for 28 home runs for next season, the top projection for any Blue Jays hitter and the same number as stars like Bryce Harper and Fernando Tatis Jr.

That's a good baseline -- and we'd buy that, since Okamoto's long track record of slugging in Japan has already successfully carried over to the Majors. And we definitely want to see a lot more majestic Okamoto golf swings going forward.
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟最佳重炮手的招牌本垒打挥棒
items.summaryZh: Kazuma Okamoto在登陆大联盟的首个赛季表现亮眼，轰出33支本垒打，成为多伦多蓝鸟阵中的核心重炮。
bodyZh: 对于一支在2026年本垒打产量在全大联盟垫底的多伦多蓝鸟队来说……谢天谢地，他们至少还有Kazuma Okamoto。
在大联盟的第一个赛季，Okamoto几乎是唯一一个能为蓝鸟队提供火力输出的打者。他敲出了多伦多全队152支本垒打中的33支，占全队总数的22%。全队本垒打占比高于他的只有光芒队的Junior Caminero（25%）、费城人队的Kyle Schwarber（25%）以及洛矶队的Hunter Goodman（23%）。
Okamoto的本垒打数是其他任何蓝鸟队打者的两倍多——排在第二位的是George Springer的15支。这也 quase 将Vladimir Guerrero Jr.在这个低迷赛季中打出的9支本垒打抛离了近四倍。
随着赛季的进行，Okamoto的招牌本垒打风格也逐渐显现：低角度内角本垒打。
Okamoto非常喜欢“高尔夫球式”的挥棒。他是上赛季联盟中最出色的右打高尔夫球式挥棒手。
Okamoto的33支本垒打中，有11支（整整赛季总数的三分之一）来自好球带低内角的投球。这是所有右打重炮手中最多的。
2026年右打者对阵低内角投球的最多本垒打
Kazuma Okamoto: 11
Hunter Goodman / Andy Pages / Zack Gelof: 7
Pete Alonso / Sal Stewart / Nolan Arenado / Salvador Perez / Ezequiel Duran: 6
在风格上，Okamoto有点像是右打版本的Yordan Alvarez。这位美联MVP在他的42支本垒打中有12支来自低内角投球，他在拉开与其他左打者（CJ Abrams、Matt Olson、Gunnar Henderson和Trent Grisham）差距的程度上，与Okamoto在右打者中的优势不相上下。
没有什么比低球打者的本垒打挥棒更宏伟的了，而Okamoto的击球在命中时堪称绝美。随着赛季的推进，他甚至加大了挥棒轨迹的倾角——这让他能更好地打出高尔夫球式的本垒打。
Okamoto各月挥棒倾角（倾角越大 = 上击弧度越大）
到年底时，Okamoto的平均挥棒倾角比赛季初陡峭了四度。这对于他所进行的强力打击风格来说非常合理。想要击中好球带低内角的来球，需要更陡峭的挥棒轨迹。
这些低内角的本垒打基本上只有一个去处：被拉打到左外野深处。Okamoto在反方向打出的低内角本垒打只有他在开幕周末打出的第一支大联盟本垒打——那是一次更平缓、推打式的挥棒，发生在他将站位往后调整、给自己更多时间让球棒前伸并对来球施力之前的几周。
在那次调整之后，他打出了大量被拉打的高飞球。这成为了Okamoto的招牌绝技。
将球在空中拉打是通往本垒打最直接的途径，在多伦多的第一个赛季中，Okamoto有27%的击球是被拉打的高飞球。这使他进入了大联盟重炮手的第90百分位，在至少有300次击球的179名打者中排名第18位。
对于这位长期效力于读卖巨人队的明星来说，这是一个极为出色的“菜鸟”赛季，如果Okamoto能在下赛季复制这样的长打表现，将对蓝鸟队重返季后赛大有助益。
那么他会在2027年再次做到这一点吗？预测数据至少认为他会非常接近。FanGraphs的Depth Charts预测Okamoto下赛季将轰出28支本垒打，这是所有蓝鸟打者中的最高预测值，与Bryce Harper和Fernando Tatis Jr.等球星的数据相同。
这是一个很好的基准——我们完全相信这一点，因为Okamoto在日本长期累积的长打实力已经成功延续到了大联盟。我们绝对希望在未来看到更多Okamoto那令人惊叹的高尔夫球式挥棒。
items.author: David Adler

items.titleEn: Blue Jays non-tender fan favorite Davis Schneider after rough '26
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have non-tendered Davis Schneider, the fan favorite who struggled to find a permanent role with the club in 2026.

Schneider’s historic debut in 2023 will forever stand as one of the greatest in Blue Jays history, when he went 9-for-13 with two home runs over three days at Fenway Park in Boston. There have been other highs since then, when Schneider’s excellent plate approach paired with his power in just the right way, but he appeared in just 69 games last season with a .145 average and .625 OPS.

All other arbitration-eligible players were tendered contracts by the Blue Jays Friday, including Ernie Clement, José Soriano, Josh Smith, Louis Varland, Nathan Lukes, Spencer Arrighetti, Addison Barger and Bowden Francis. The Blue Jays’ 40-man roster is now at 39 players.

The 27-year-old Schneider, who was a remarkable development prospect as a 28th-round pick out of high school in 2017, split last season between the big leagues and Triple-A Buffalo. Few players in the organization could rival Schneider’s pitch recognition, which led to Schneider walking more than once per game in Triple-A (57 in 52 games), but we didn’t see as much of Schneider’s power to counter that. At several points throughout the season, Blue Jays manager John Schneider said that he wanted to see more big swings on pitches in the zone.

It’s possible that Schneider finds a larger opportunity elsewhere, but in Toronto, it felt like his pathways to big league playing time in 2027 may have been limited, especially if another outfielder is added. Schneider has plenty of baseball ahead of him, though, and if he can find the right balance between his plate approach and power again, he could soon find himself right back in the big leagues. He deserves credit, too, for turning himself into a solid corner outfielder, which gives him a broader defensive profile.

Otherwise, the Blue Jays’ tender deadline decisions weren’t much of a decision at all. While Clement faded down the stretch, his profile still fits this team very well. Smith may have been the other Toronto player closest to a true “decision” here, but the Blue Jays liked what they saw down the stretch and believed he could tap into more power.

This has been a quiet start to the offseason for Toronto, but with business picking up around the league, the Blue Jays are expected to be involved at every level of the market. They are among the teams who have met with Tarik Skubal, who could set the new MLB record for the highest annual salary paid to a pitcher, and they remain an excellent fit for outfielder Seiya Suzuki, who has a fine case as the top position player available.
items.titleZh: 经历2026年低迷后，蓝鸟选择不予供职合同裁掉深受球迷喜爱的Davis Schneider
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟未对Davis Schneider提供新合同，其余有薪资仲裁资格的球员均获续约合同。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯 -- 多伦多蓝鸟决定不对Davis Schneider提供新合同，这位深受球迷喜爱的球员在2026赛季一直难以在球队中找到固定的角色。
Schneider在2023年历史性的惊艳大联盟首秀将永远作为多伦多蓝鸟队史最伟大的首秀之一被铭记，当时他在波士顿芬威球场的三天内13打数9安打并敲出2支本垒打。此后他也曾有过其他的高光时刻，当时Schneider出色的选球策略与他的长续航能力完美结合，但他在上个赛季仅出场69场，打击率为.145，OPS为.625。
蓝鸟在周五对所有其他具备薪资仲裁资格的球员提供了合同，其中包括Ernie Clement、José Soriano、Josh Smith、Louis Varland、Nathan Lukes、Spencer Arrighetti、Addison Barger和Bowden Francis。多伦多蓝鸟的40人名单目前人数为39人。

现年27岁的Schneider作为2017年高中毕业的第28轮新秀曾是一名出色的发展期潜力新秀，他在上个赛季在大联盟和小联盟三A水牛城之间度过。球队中很少有球员能比肩Schneider的球路识别能力，这使得他在三A时期的场均保送次数超过一次（在52场比赛中获得57次保送），但我们并没有看到足够多的长打能力来与此抗衡。在整个赛季的多个时间点，多伦多蓝鸟总教练John Schneider曾表示，他希望看到对好球带内的球有更多大力的挥击。
Schneider有可能在其他地方找到更大的发展机会，但在多伦多，感觉他在2027年进入大联盟的出场时间途径可能会受到限制，特别是如果再引进一名外场手的话。不过，Schneider的棒球生涯还有很长，如果他能再次在选球策略和长打能力之间找到合适的平衡，他可能很快就会重返大联盟。他也值得赞赏，因为他把自己塑造成为一名扎实的角落外场手，这让他的防守属性更加全面。
除此之外，多伦多蓝鸟在续约截止日期的决定其实并没有太多悬念。尽管Clement在赛季末段状态下滑，但他的球风仍然非常适合这支球队。Smith可能是多伦多另一位最接近真正需要“做决定”的球员，但蓝鸟喜欢他在赛季末展现出的表现，并相信他能挖掘出更多的长打能力。
对多伦多而言，这个休赛期的开局比较平静，但随着全联盟的业务逐渐升温，多伦多蓝鸟预计将参与到市场各个层面的运作中。他们是曾与Tarik Skubal会面的球队之一，后者可能会创下投手臂展最高年薪的MLB纪录，并且他们依然非常适合引进外场手Seiya Suzuki，后者完全有资格成为市场上最优秀的野手人选。

items.titleEn: How a UFO encounter in 1961 led to Double-A New Hampshire’s weirdest alternate identity
bodyEn: MANCHESTER, N.H. -- Taylor Fisher had already been working in Minor League Baseball for about 10 years when he was hired by the New Hampshire Fisher Cats (Double-A affiliate of the Toronto Blue Jays), yet he immediately saw that he was entering a whole new world.
“I walked in on my first day as general manager here, and on the white board next to me it just said, ‘Space Potatoes,’” Fisher recalled. “I said, ‘What the heck did that mean?’”

That was in 2024. Now, at the end of 2026, Fisher and baseball fans across New England know exactly what the phrase means. The New Hampshire Space Potatoes have become a beloved alternate identity, adopted by the Fisher Cats for a total of nine home games over the past two seasons.
But where did "Space Potatoes" come from? It’s an idea that ties together two little-known pieces of New Hampshire history.

The first pertains to historical fact. In 1719, on land in the current-day New Hampshire town of Derry, Scots-Irish settlers planted the first white potatoes grown in North America. In 2013, fourth graders from the Derry Village School successfully lobbied to have the white potato named the official state vegetable.

The second sits at the nexus of the known universe and the realm of possibility. About 80 miles north-northwest of the Fisher Cats’ ballpark in Manchester is the spot where the first widely reported alien abduction in American history allegedly took place in 1961.
“So, you mash those two together, you get the Space Potatoes,” Fisher Cats assistant GM Andrew Marais said.

Marais, like many Space Potatoes fans, is a UFO believer. Every year when he takes an hour drive into the White Mountains, he stops at an alien-themed gas station and passes a roadside marker on the highway in the town of Lincoln. That sign reads:

On the night of September 19-20, 1961, Portsmouth, NH couple Betty and Barney Hill experienced a close encounter with an unidentified flying object and two hours of “lost” time while driving south on Rte. 3 near Lincoln. They filed an official Air Force Project Blue Book report of a brightly-lit cigar-shaped craft the next day, but were not public with their story until it was leaked to the Boston Traveler in 1965. This was the first widely-reported UFO abduction in the United States.
That’s the story. Is there anything to it?

Michael Clair, MLB.com’s resident expert on international baseball and intergalactic lifeforms, says it’s worth considering the Hills’ accounts of the incident as well as the way those accounts become public. Emphasizing that the Hills were an interracial couple and were both civil workers who never sought or wanted media attention, Clair points out that many of the details of their abduction weren't revealed until after they underwent hypnotic regression therapy years after the incident.

Among those details: the Hills pulled off the highway onto a small, rural road and encountered beings who encouraged the couple to get out of their car. They were brought onto a craft, separated, examined and questioned.

“At one point they come into Betty’s room,” Clair said, “and start pulling on her teeth and saying, ‘Why aren’t your teeth coming out? Why are Barney’s teeth coming out?’ (They didn’t say his name.) And she said, ‘He has dentures. It happens when you get older.’ They didn’t understand age. They asked her multiple times, ‘What is older?’ She had to explain human aging to them.

“They also both remember grey-faced creatures with a larger skull ... [a] forehead that gets narrower below with almost no nose and a flat mouth. That is the common depiction of what is commonly known as ‘greys,’ grey aliens.”

Austin Cates, the Blue Jays’ No. 30 prospect, didn’t learn the specifics of the Hill incident until a couple months after he’d already pitched as a Space Potato. A native of Nevada, Cates has long been open to the possibility that Area 51 holds proof of extraterrestrial life. Hearing that the Hills initially reported their experience only to the government, he was convinced they’d told the truth.
“That’s crazy!” he said. “Yeah. Aliens are real. I’ll throw it out there. I’ll say they’re real.”
Waiting in line at the gates to receive a Trey Yesevage-Space Potatoes bobblehead before the game on Sept. 18, a regular at Fisher Cats games named Jake was also pretty sure the story was legitimate.
“If somebody says it happened, more than likely there’s some truth to it,” he said.
And if word of the Fisher Cats’ alternate identity should travel? If flying saucers were to show up at Delta Dental Stadium?
It’s a risk the New Hampshire front office is willing to take.
“It would boost attendance,” Fisher said, “and that’s what matters. Butts in seats.”
items.titleZh: 1961年的UFO遭遇事件如何衍生出双城新罕布什尔最奇特的变装身份
items.summaryZh: 新罕布什尔Fisher Cats队将地方土豆历史与1961年UFO事件结合，推出了极具特色的“太空土豆”替代身份。
bodyZh: 曼彻斯特，新罕布什尔州——Taylor Fisher在被多伦多蓝鸟的双A附属球队新罕布什尔Fisher Cats队雇用之前，已经在小联盟棒球界工作了大约10年，但他一上任就发现自己进入了一个全新世界。
“我作为这里的总经理第一天走进办公室，身边的白板上就写着‘太空土豆’，”Fisher回忆道。“我说，‘这到底是什么意思？’”
那是2024年。现在，到了2026年底，Fisher和新英格兰各地的棒球球迷都完全明白了这句话的意思。新罕布什尔太空土豆队已经成为一个备受喜爱的替代身份，在过去两个赛季中，Fisher Cats队在总共九场主场比赛中使用了这一身份。
但“太空土豆”是从哪里来的？这个创意将新罕布什尔州两段鲜为人知的历史联系在了一起。
第一部分涉及历史事实。1719年，在现今新罕布什尔州德里镇的土地上，苏格兰-爱尔兰移民种植了北美洲第一批白土豆。2013年，来自德里村学校的四年级学生成功游说将白土豆命名为官方州蔬菜。
第二部分则位于已知宇宙与可能性领域的交汇点。在曼彻斯特Fisher Cats队球场以北约80英里北-西北方向，是美国历史上第一起广为人知的遭遇外星人绑架事件据称于1961年发生的地方。
“所以，你把这两者结合起来，就得到了太空土豆，”Fisher Cats队的助理总经理Andrew Marais说。
Marais和许多太空土豆队的球迷一样，是一位UFO信徒。每年当他开车一个小时进入怀特山脉时，他都会在一个外星人主题的加油站停下来，并驶过林肯镇公路上的一块路标。那个标牌上写着：
1961年9月19日至20日夜晚，新罕布什尔州朴茨茅斯的夫妇Betty和Barney Hill在林肯附近的3号公路向南驾驶时，经历了一次与不明飞行物的近距离接触，并有两小时的“消失”时间。他们第二天向空军蓝皮书计划提交了一份关于一个发光雪茄形飞行物的官方报告，但直到1965年泄露给《波士顿旅行者报》之前，他们的故事并未公开。这是美国第一起广为人知的UFO绑架事件。
这就是故事。这里面有什么门道吗？
MLB.com的国际棒球和星际生命形式常驻专家Michael Clair表示，研究Hill夫妇对该事件的描述以及这些描述公之于众的方式是值得的。Clair强调，Hill夫妇是一对跨种族夫妇，两人都是从未寻求或想要媒体关注的公务员，并指出他们绑架案的许多细节直到事件发生多年后接受催眠回归疗法才被揭示。
在这些细节中：Hill夫妇将车开离高速公路，驶入一条狭窄的乡村小路，并遇到了鼓励这对夫妇下车的生物。他们被带到一个飞行器上，分开、检查并接受盘问。
“有一度他们来到Betty的房间，”Clair说，“开始拉扯她的牙齿并说，‘为什么你的牙齿没有掉下来？为什么Barney的牙齿在掉？’（他们没有说他的名字。）她说，‘他装有假牙。人老了就会这样。’他们不理解年龄。他们多次问她，‘什么是老？’她不得不向他们解释人类的衰老过程。
“他们还都记得灰面生物，有着更大的头骨……[一个]前额向下变窄，几乎没有鼻子，嘴巴扁平。那是通常被称为‘灰人’、灰色外星人的常见描绘。”
蓝鸟队排名第30位的潜力新秀Austin Cates，直到他作为太空土豆队投球几个月后才了解到Hill事件的具体细节。作为内华达州本地人，Cates长期以来一直对51区掌握地外生命证据的可能性持开放态度。听到Hill夫妇最初只向政府报告了他们的经历，他确信他们说的是实话。
“太疯狂了！”他说。“是的。外星人是真实的。我把它说出来。我说它们是真实的。”
在9月18日比赛前排队领取Trey Yesevage-太空土豆摇头娃娃的Fisher Cats队常客Jake也确信这个故事是合法的。
“如果有人说它发生了，多半其中包含一些真相，”他说。
如果Fisher Cats队这个替代身份的消息传出去了呢？如果飞碟出现在三角牙科体育场呢？
这是新罕布什尔管理层愿意承担的风险。
“这会提升上座率，”Fisher说，“而这才是最重要的。座位上得坐满人。”

items.titleEn: Vladdy Jr. hoping to suit up in Dominican Winter League -- if Blue Jays will let him
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. wants to play ball this winter.

On Tuesday, Guerrero’s rights in the Liga de Béisbol Profesional de la República Dominicana (LIDOM) were traded from Toros del Este to Tigres del Licey, the historic club where his father took the final at-bats of his Hall of Fame career in November 2012.

It wasn’t immediately clear if Guerrero would ever play for Tigres -- and he’d never taken an at-bat in the Dominican Winter League with Toros -- but then Wednesday came. There was Guerrero, climbing the dugout steps at Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal to take batting practice in Tigres gear. It all looked eerily familiar, in the Tigres’ shade of blue that’s so similar to Guerrero’s colors in Toronto.
Soon after taking some swings in the cage, Guerrero met with the Dominican media, seated alongside Tigres general manager Audo Vicente.
“It means a lot to me. Since I was a kid, I always admired this team and always dreamed about being here,” Guerrero said in Spanish. “And today, one of my dreams is coming true.”
This is a homecoming of sorts for Guerrero, given his family ties, but there’s just one question that Blue Jays fans care about this winter: Is Guerrero going to play?

“We’re working on getting the [Blue Jays’] approval,” Guerrero said in Spanish. “They’re the ones who will ultimately say yes or no. I can’t give you a definite date for that, but we’re working on it in order to be here and play with Licey as soon as possible.”

In LIDOM, clubs have incredibly deep rosters, holding rights to many Major League players who might never suit up for them. In fact, in 2023, Guerrero was traded from his original LIDOM club, Leones del Escogido, to Toros del Este for Guardians superstar José Ramírez. While Ramírez played a handful of games for Leones, Guerrero never suited up for Toros.

Rosters can change dramatically throughout the season, too, and the talent ranges from top prospects to big leaguers from long ago. On Tigres del Licey’s roster, you’ll find the No. 1 prospect in baseball, 19-year-old Jesús Made. On that very same roster, you’ll also find former Blue Jays outfielder Emilio Bonifácio, still going strong at 41.

Tigres could boast one of the greatest collections of talent in LIDOM this season. But that always hinges on star players getting permission from his club, especially if those players have an MLB contract with a lot of commas in them.

Scroll down the list of players under Tigres' control and you’ll find some impressive names, but Guerrero has a big one in mind: Juan Soto. The Mets’ star has never played in games with Tigres, but they hold his LIDOM rights, and Soto recently spent some time on the field with the club before one of its home games. In fact, when Guerrero was traded to Tigres, Soto was the first person to text him.
“It would be a dream,” Guerrero said. “We already did that in the Classic, and to do it here on Tigres del Licey is important, if he also gets permission to play [from the Mets].”

The risk of injury in winter ball is always present, which is why we don’t see as many established big leaguers playing compared to 20 or 30 years ago. Their MLB contracts are a factor in all of this, of course, but it’s also easy to see why Guerrero is eager to play and how this could benefit everyone involved if he eventually does.

Guerrero is coming off a dreadful season with the Blue Jays, a stunning letdown after his 2025 World Series run. Right up until Game 7 against the Dodgers, Guerrero looked like an unstoppable talent, a franchise player who had finally unlocked his final form. Then, ‘26 landed with a thud -- a .688 OPS with just nine home runs.

Mentally, Guerrero could be eager to get a jump on his fresh start, but this could also work as an early workshop for any potential swing changes. Guerrero has long resisted any noticeable overhaul to his swing, which is complex and relies heavily on his timing with a dozen moving parts coming together at once. Beyond the family ties and how meaningful LIDOM is to these Dominican stars, any opportunity to face live pitching with something at stake can only benefit Guerrero at this point.
Tigres are near the midway point of the LIDOM season, which stretches until Dec. 22.
items.titleZh: Vladdy Jr.希望能打多米尼加冬季联盟——只要蓝鸟允许的话
items.summaryZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.希望能参加多米尼加冬季联盟比赛，但他目前正在等待多伦多蓝鸟的批准。
bodyZh: 多伦多——Vladimir Guerrero Jr.想要在这个冬天打球。
周二，Guerrero在多米尼加共和国职业棒球联赛（LIDOM）的效力权从东部公牛队（Toros del Este）被交易到了Licey老虎队（Tigres del Licey），这是一支历史悠久的球队，他的父亲曾在2012年11月在这里度过了他名人堂职业生涯的最后几个打席。
目前尚不清楚Guerrero是否会为老虎队出场——此前他在公牛队时从未在多米尼加冬季联盟有过打席——但随后周三到了。Guerrero出现在那里，走上Quisqueya Juan Marichal球场的休息区台阶，身穿老虎队的装备进行打击练习。这一切看起来诡异地熟悉，老虎队的蓝色调与Guerrero在多伦多的颜色非常相似。
在笼内进行了一些挥棒练习后不久，Guerrero与多米尼加媒体见面，与老虎队总经理Audo Vicente坐在一起。
“这对我意义重大。从小到大，我一直很崇拜这支球队，并一直梦想着来到这里，”Guerrero用西班牙语说道，“今天，我的一个梦想正在成真。”
考虑到他的家庭纽带，这可以说是Guerrero的一种回归，但今年冬天蓝鸟球迷只关心一个问题：Guerrero会打球吗？
“我们正在努力获得[蓝鸟队]的批准，”Guerrero用西班牙语说道，“他们才是最终说行或不行的人。我无法给你一个确切的日期，但我们正在努力，以便尽快来到这里并为Licey效力。”
在LIDOM中，各队的阵容极其深厚，拥有许多可能永远不会为他们效力的大联盟球员的权益。事实上，在2023年，Guerrero从他最初的LIDOM球队Escogido狮子队（Leones del Escogido）被交易到东部公牛队，换取了守护者队的超级巨星José Ramírez。虽然Ramírez为狮子队打了几场比赛，但Guerrero从未为公牛队出场。
整个赛季阵容也可能发生巨大变化，人才从顶级潜力新秀到昔日大联盟球员应有尽有。在Licey老虎队的阵容中，你会发现棒球界排名第一的潜力新秀、19岁的Jesús Made。在同一个阵容中，你还会发现前蓝鸟队外野手Emilio Bonifácio，他在41岁时依然状态神勇。
本赛季老虎队可能会拥有LIDOM中最伟大的人才阵容之一。但这总是取决于球星是否能获得其俱乐部的许可，尤其是当这些球员拥有价值不菲的MLB合同的时候。
顺着老虎队控制的球员名单往下看，你会发现一些令人印象深刻的名字，但Guerrero心里有一个大牌：Juan Soto。这位大都会队的球星从未与老虎队一起打过比赛，但他们拥有他的LIDOM权益，Soto最近在球队的一场主场比赛前在球场上待了一段时间。事实上，当Guerrero被交易到老虎队时，Soto是第一个发短信给他的人。
“这将是一个梦想，”Guerrero说，“我们已经在经典赛中做到过这一点，如果他也能获得[大都会队的]参赛许可，能在Licey老虎队再次做到这一点很重要。”
冬联受伤的风险始终存在，这就是为什么与20或30年前相比，我们看到的大牌大联盟球员没有那么多。当然，他们的MLB合同是这一切的一个因素，但也很容易看出为什么Guerrero渴望打球，以及如果他最终这样做，这最终将如何让所有相关人员受益。
Guerrero刚刚在蓝鸟队度过了一个糟糕的赛季，这是在他2025年世界大赛之旅后令人震惊的失望。直到对阵道奇队的第7场比赛为止，Guerrero看起来都像是一个势不可挡的天才，一个终于解锁了最终形态的球队基石。然后，'26赛季惨淡收场——OPS只有.688，仅有9个本垒打。
在心理上，Guerrero可能渴望开启一个新的开始，但这也可以作为任何潜在挥棒调整的早期工作坊。Guerrero长期以来一直抗拒对他复杂的挥棒进行任何明显的彻底改造，他的挥棒非常复杂，高度依赖于十几个同时运作的活动部件之间的时机。除了家庭纽带以及LIDOM对这些多米尼加球星的重要意义之外，任何在有奖金的情况下与实战投球对决的机会，在目前这个阶段对Guerrero都只有好处。
老虎队正接近LIDOM赛季的中程，该赛季将持续到12月22日。

items.titleEn: Vladdy gets traded -- in Dominican Winter League
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Take a deep breath before you read this one and let’s begin by making one thing very clear: This is a trade in the Dominican Winter League.

Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been traded from Toros del Este to Tigres del Licey in exchange for relievers Misael Tamárez and Cam Robinson, a blockbuster in Liga de Béisbol Profesional de la República Dominicana (LIDOM). This doesn't impact the Blue Jays directly in any way, but it’s a major headline Tuesday night in the Dominican Republic.

Guerrero has not played in LIDOM since the 2020-21 offseason, when he used that as part of his campaign to remain at third base. He’s since found a permanent home at first, and in the years since, Guerrero has been traded multiple times in LIDOM, where clubs can hold onto a Major League players’ rights even if they don’t play in Winter Ball.

Vladdy’s original LIDOM team was Leones del Escogido, who he debuted for in 2017-18, just as he was about to take the baseball world by storm as the No. 1 prospect in the game. Just a few years ago, though, in 2023, Guerrero was traded to the Toros Del Este for Guardians superstar José Ramírez. Guerrero never played for Toros, but Ramírez actually appeared in 10 games for Leones in the 2023-24 offseason.

Whether Guerrero will play for Tigres this LIDOM season is still unclear, but he’ll now have that option and there’s a family tie for the young star, as there often is. His father, Vladimir Guerrero, took the final at-bats of his Hall of Fame career in a Tigres uniform. In 2012-13, the elder Guerrero appeared in eight games for Tigres, who play their home games at the famous Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic.
Tigres are already one month into the LIDOM season, which stretches until Dec. 22.

items.titleEn: Blue Jays add No. 2 prospect, 2 others in Top 30 to 40-man roster
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays added three prospects to their 40-man roster Tuesday, protecting right-hander Nolan Perry, right-hander Daniel Guerra and outfielder RJ Schreck from the Rule 5 Draft.

The Blue Jays seriously considered several other prospects who are now Rule 5 eligible, but this trio brings Toronto’s 40-man roster to a full 40. From this point on, any offseason additions will also require a counter-move to free up space.
The Rule 5 Draft is scheduled to take place on Dec. 9 at the Winter Meetings in San Diego.

Perry is the headliner of this group after skyrocketing up prospect lists over the past year, landing at No. 2 on the Blue Jays’ Top 30 list and No. 90 on the MLB Top 100. In a farm system that has made significant strides in pitching development over the past two years, Perry is at the front of a wave that could soon show up in the big leagues. It has taken some patience, but finally, these development projects are turning the corner.
This is a massive success story for everyone involved, led by Perry himself, a 12th-round pick out of high school in the 2022 MLB Draft.

After Perry missed the 2025 season due to Tommy John surgery, it felt like he was fading from the prospect picture before even gaining much traction, but he was one of the hottest names in Spring Training this past year and immediately turned that into results. Across three levels, Perry posted a 2.50 ERA with 117 strikeouts over 82 2/3 innings. Much of this was built on top of a velocity bump, too, now sitting comfortably in the mid-90s.

Perry finished his season by making nine starts with Double-A New Hampshire, so if he doesn’t open the 2027 season in Triple-A Buffalo, he should be there quickly. Now 23, Perry is close enough to kick the door down at any time, which the Blue Jays have been waiting on.

Outside of Trey Yesavage, whose meteoric rise in 2025 will be a blueprint teams chase for years, the Blue Jays haven’t produced enough reliable starting depth internally. In some situations, that has also been for good reason, as the organization has traded several top pitching prospects in deals.

Guerra, the club’s No. 15 prospect, built upon his breakout 2025 season with an encore in ‘26, posting a 3.33 ERA with 107 strikeouts over 78 1/3 innings across all five levels of the system. Guerra eventually reached Triple-A and, like Perry, could be an option for the Blue Jays in the short-term if all goes well. The big 22-year-old stands 6-foot-6, and as an international signing out of Venezuela for just $40,000 in ‘22, he is another standout development story for this organization.
Moving off the mound, though, Schreck (No. 12) might have the most immediate impact of the bunch.

Acquired from the Mariners for Justin Turner back at the 2024 Trade Deadline, Schreck is a very “Blue Jays” style of hitting prospect. His contact rates dipped a bit in 2026 as he dealt with injuries, but he owns a .383 on-base percentage through the Minor Leagues. Power isn’t Schreck’s calling card, but think of him as being similar to Nathan Lukes, a solid, all-around hitter with a high floor.

Schreck is already 26, so the development conversation can take a back seat at this point. If Toronto has a need, he’ll play. The Blue Jays are still expected to add to their outfield this offseason, with Seiya Suzuki continuing to represent a near-perfect option for them, but the depth picture is blurry.

Myles Straw is a free agent now, leaving Davis Schneider and Yohendrick Piñango as potential reserve options in the corners. Anthony Santander is expected to be healthy for camp, too, but after he played just 54 below-average games over two injury-plagued seasons, it’s difficult to have much confidence. It’s very possible Schreck gets a shot to compete for a job in Spring Training, especially if Addison Barger (elbow surgery) is not ready for Opening Day.

The Blue Jays will still have some quality prospects exposed in the Rule 5 Draft, a list that includes Gage Stanifer (No. 9), who had plenty of momentum coming into the season but lost some of that with an inconsistent year. The versatile Jay Harry (No. 21) and infielder Josh Kasevich (No. 13) were also eligible to be protected Tuesday, but were not added.
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟将二号潜力新秀等三人加入40人名单
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟将三名潜力新秀加入40人名单，以防他们在规则五选秀中被选走。
bodyZh: 多伦多电 —— 多伦多蓝鸟周二将三名潜力新秀加入40人名单，将右投手Nolan Perry、右投手Daniel Guerra以及外野手RJ Schreck保护起来，免受规则五选秀的影响。
蓝鸟曾认真考虑过其他几位目前符合规则五选秀资格的潜力新秀，但这三人的加入使多伦多蓝鸟的40人名单达到满额。从现在开始，任何休赛期的引援也都需要通过相应的球员变动来腾出空间。
规则五选秀计划于12月9日在圣迭戈的冬季会议上举行。
在过去一年中潜力新秀排名飙升之后，Nolan Perry成为了这批球员中的头条人物，他目前在多伦多蓝鸟的前30名潜力新秀榜单中排在第2位，在MLB前100名中排在第90位。在一个在过去两年中投手培养取得显著进步的小联盟体系中，Nolan Perry正处于可能很快登上大联盟的一股浪潮的最前沿。这需要一些耐心，但最终这些培养项目正在迎来转机。
对于所有参与其中的人来说，这是一个巨大的成功故事，其中领衔的是Nolan Perry本人，他是2022年MLB选秀中在高中轮次被选中的第12轮新秀。

在Nolan Perry因托马斯·约翰手肘韧带重建手术（Tommy John surgery）缺席了2025赛季之后，感觉他在还没获得太多关注之前就已经淡出了潜力新秀的视野，但他在今年春训中成为了最炙手可热的名字之一，并立即将这一点转化为了赛场上的表现。跨越三个层级，Nolan Perry在82又2/3局的投球中交出了2.50的自责分率，并送出117次三振。这很大程度上也建立在球速提升的基础之上，他现在的球速已经能够稳定在90英里/小时的中段。
Nolan Perry以在2A新罕布什尔的9次先发结束了他的赛季，因此如果他没有在2027赛季从3A布法罗开始，他也应该会很快到达那里。现年23岁的Nolan Perry已经足够接近随时敲开大联盟的大门，这也是多伦多蓝鸟一直在等待的。
除了Trey Yesavage之外——他在2025年的火箭式崛起将成为各队多年来追逐的蓝图——多伦多蓝鸟在内部并没有培养出足够可靠的先发投手深度。在某些情况下，这也是有充分理由的，因为该组织在多笔交易中送出了几位顶尖投手潜力新秀。

Daniel Guerra作为俱乐部的第15号潜力新秀，在他2025年的爆发赛季基础上，在26赛季再接再厉，在整个小联盟系统的全部五个层级中，于78又1/3局的投球里交出了3.33的自责分率，并有107次三振。Daniel Guerra最终晋升至3A，并且和Nolan Perry一样，如果一切顺利，短期内可能会成为多伦多蓝鸟的一个备选方案。这位22岁的大个子身高6英尺6英寸，作为2022年以4万美元从委内瑞拉签下的国际球员，他是该组织另一个出色的培养成功案例。
不过，抛开投手丘不谈，RJ Schreck（第12号）可能是这批球员中产生最直接影响的人。
RJ Schreck是在2024年交易截止日为换取Justin Turner从西雅图水手交易得到的，他是一名非常具有“多伦多蓝鸟”风格的打击潜力新秀。由于受到伤病困扰，他在2026年的安打率有所下降，但他在小联盟中拥有.383的上垒率。力量并不是RJ Schreck的长项，但你可以认为他类似于Nathan Lukes，是一位基础扎实、攻守全面且下限很高的打者。
RJ Schreck已经26岁了，所以在这一点上，关于培养的讨论可以退居其次。如果多伦多蓝鸟有需求，他就会上场。多伦多蓝鸟预计仍将在今夏休赛期补强外野，鈴木誠也继续代表着他们近乎完美的引援选择，但深度阵容的情况仍有些模糊。

Myles Straw现在是一名自由球员，这使得Davis Schneider和Yohendrick Piñango成为角落外野的潜在替补选择。Anthony Santander预计也将在训练营保持健康，但在经历了两个因伤病困扰、仅出场54场且表现低于平均水平的赛季之后，很难对他抱有太多信心。RJ Schreck很有可能获得在春训中竞争位置的机会，特别是如果Addison Barger（手肘手术）无法在揭幕战准备就绪的话。
多伦多蓝鸟在规则五选秀中仍将有一些优质的潜力新秀暴露在风险之中，其中包括Gage Stanifer（第9号），他在进入本赛季时有着强劲的势头，但由于一个表现不稳定的赛季而失去了一些光彩。多面手Jay Harry（第21号）和内野手Josh Kasevich（第13号）在周二也符合被保护的资格，但并未被加入名单。

items.titleEn: Here's the latest on the players Toronto could look to acquire
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The early weeks of each offseason tend to follow the same script, and this November, we’re flipping through those pages quickly.

Once the buzz of free agency wears off, the trade market always represents the next level of excitement in the MLB offseason. November is a time for dreaming, whether you’re a fan of a contender looking to repeat or a disappointment -- like the Blue Jays -- trying to climb that mountain again.
Coming off a weekend in which trade speculation dominated the discourse for Blue Jays fans, some notes on the market:
Nothing new … yet … on Ketel Marte

The Blue Jays will remain linked to Ketel Marte until his situation with the D-backs is settled, one way or another. Nothing has changed in recent days, though. The Blue Jays are interested, and very much should be interested in a player of Marte’s caliber, but they’re not about to overextend themselves at the current ask.
In a thin market for power bats, where can the Blue Jays turn?

Our D-backs reporter, Steve Gilbert, reported the same over the weekend, adding there’s “nothing new” regarding Marte. The initial conversations are certainly happening, including with one of the Blue Jays’ AL East rivals in the Orioles. Our Jake Rill reported over the weekend that the Orioles have held dialogue with the D-backs.
Still, it’s easy to see why the Blue Jays continue to be linked to Marte, and why that interest stretches back to last offseason.

Marte, now 33, is one of the game’s top offensive talents at second base, widely underrated even after 12 excellent seasons in Arizona. He’s coming off a messy season, though, including the headlines when he failed to show up for a game in Boston, then was eventually placed on the restricted list and IL. When he was on the field, it was a down year, as he posted a .249 average with 22 homers and a .748 OPS over 141 games.

Unfortunately, that “down year” still would have made Marte one of the Blue Jays’ top hitters. Over the three seasons before 2026, Marte hit .283 with an .887 OPS, averaging 30 home runs per year. If the Blue Jays and other suitors believe there’s still some of that left for Marte’s mid-30s, he is clearly one of the most attractive players available, a talent who could completely change a lineup.

One complicating factor is Marte’s contract, which still has four seasons remaining and a player option for 2031. It’s a complex deal with $89.25 million in guaranteed money remaining. He also holds 10-and-5 rights, meaning he’d need to approve any trade. That financial commitment would factor into the package the D-backs demand, but if the Blue Jays need any help getting Marte to accept a trade to Toronto, they can lean on Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Marte is married to Guerrero’s cousin.
Other options and assets

The trade market will have some other headliners, including Corey Seager from the Rangers, but the Blue Jays aren’t expected to be big players in that market. There are also younger options still under club control, like Dylan Crews of the Nationals. However, the Blue Jays would be wise to explore free agency first. They remain a perfect fit for Seiya Suzuki, who’s one of the top players available and expected to land a deal worth north of $20 million per season.

The Blue Jays’ front office is still wrongly tagged as conservative. Over and over again, this front office has dealt top-ranked prospects and former No. 1 picks, and more often than not, they’ve nailed those moves. Prospect capital will not be an issue and the Blue Jays can shop in any market.

Don’t forget their big league options, either. Depth players like Charles McAdoo or Sean Keys could represent a “right now” piece if the Blue Jays are dealing with a rebuilder, while Brandon Valenzuela is an attractive name across the league right now … but it would take a lot for the Blue Jays to move him.
The truth
Rarely do the Blue Jays make the obvious move on the trade market. We need to acknowledge that out loud.
There are plenty of recent examples, like the Louis Varland deal, which came completely out of left field, but they have worked very well.

A more useful example here -- given that the Blue Jays may be shopping for an infielder -- is the Andrés Giménez trade two years ago. That was not a hot name on X and not an aggregation darling. As fun as it is to predict the offseason, the Blue Jays have repeatedly surprised us on the trade market, so the safest bet of all might be the mystery box.
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟潜在引援目标最新动态
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了多伦多蓝鸟在休赛期的潜在交易目标及市场最新动态。
bodyZh: 多伦多消息 -- 每个休赛期的初期往往都遵循着相同的剧本，而今年11月，我们正在快速翻过这些页码。
一旦自由球员市场的热潮消退，交易市场总是代表着MLB休赛期激动人心的下一个阶段。11月是一个充满梦想的时期卷土重来的时期，无论你是渴望卫冕的争冠球队球迷，还是像多伦多蓝鸟这样试图再次攀登高峰的失意者。
在经历了一个交易猜测主导多伦多蓝鸟球迷讨论的周末之后，以下是关于市场的一些观察：
关于Ketel Marte……暂无新进展
在Ketel Marte与亚利桑那响尾蛇的情况以某种方式解决之前，多伦多蓝鸟将继续与他联系在一起。不过，最近几天情况没有任何改变。多伦多蓝鸟对此感兴趣，并且非常应该对Ketel Marte这个级别的球员感兴趣，但他们不打算在目前的要价上过度勉强自己。
在缺乏强力打者的市场中，多伦多蓝鸟可以转向哪里？
我们的亚利桑那响尾蛇记者Steve Gilbert在周末报道了同样的情况，并补充说关于Ketel Marte“没有新进展”。初步接触肯定在进行中，包括与多伦多蓝鸟在美国联盟东区的一位死敌巴尔的摩金莺。我们的Jake Rill在周末报道称，巴尔的摩金莺已经与亚利桑那响尾蛇进行了对话。
尽管如此，我们很容易理解为什么多伦多蓝鸟继续与Ketel Marte联系在一起，以及为什么这种兴趣可以追溯到上一个休赛期。
现年33岁的Ketel Marte是二垒位置上联盟顶尖的进攻人才之一，即使在亚利桑那经历了12个出色的赛季后，他依然被广泛低估。不过，他刚刚度过了一个混乱的赛季，包括他在波士顿的一场比赛中缺席而登上头条新闻，随后最终被放入限制名单和伤病名单。当他上场时，这是一个低迷的赛季，他在141场比赛中交出了.249的打击率，有22支本垒打和.748的上垒率加长打率。
不幸的是，这个“低迷的赛季”仍然会让Ketel Marte成为多伦多蓝鸟最顶尖的打者之一。在2026年之前的三个赛季里，Ketel Marte的打击率为.283，上垒率加长打率为.887，平均每年贡献30支本垒打。如果多伦多蓝鸟和其他追求者相信Ketel Marte在30岁中期仍能保持这样的状态，他显然是市场上最具吸引力的球员之一，这位天才可以彻底改变一整条打线。

一个复杂的因素是Ketel Marte的合同，该合同还剩四个赛季，并在2031年拥有球员选项。这是一份复杂的合同，还剩8925万美元的保障薪资。他还拥有10-and-5特权，这意味着他必须批准任何交易。这种财务承诺将成为亚利桑那响尾蛇要求的筹码的一部分，但如果多伦多蓝鸟需要任何帮助来让Ketel Marte接受前往多伦多的交易，他们可以依靠Vladimir Guerrero Jr.。Ketel Marte是Vladimir Guerrero Jr.表姐的丈夫。
其他选项与资产
交易市场将有一些其他的头条人物，包括得克萨斯游骑兵的Corey Seager，但预计多伦多蓝鸟不会成为该市场的主导者。还有一些仍在球团控制之下的年轻选项，比如华盛顿国民的Dylan Crews。然而，多伦多蓝鸟明智的做法是先探索自由球员市场。他们依然是Seiya Suzuki的完美契合对象，后者是市场上最顶级的球员之一，预计将获得一份每个赛季价值超过2000万美元的合同。
多伦多蓝鸟的管理层仍然被错误地贴上了保守的标签。一次又一次，这个管理层送出了顶级潜力新秀和前状元秀，而且大多数时候，他们都成功了。潜力新秀资本不会成为问题，多伦多蓝鸟可以在任何市场上采购。
也不要忘记他们在大联盟级别的选项。如果多伦多蓝鸟正在与一支重建球队做生意，Charles McAdoo或Sean Keys等深度球员可能代表着“即战力”筹码，而Brandon Valenzuela目前是全联盟备受吸引的名字……但多伦多蓝鸟需要付出很大代价才能交易他。
真相
多伦多蓝鸟在交易市场上很少做出显而易见的运作。我们需要大声承认这一点。
最近有很多例子，比如Louis Varland的交易，完全出人意料，但他们的效果非常好。
这里一个更有用的例子——鉴于多伦多蓝鸟可能在寻找一名内野手——是两年前的Andrés Giménez交易。那不是X（原推特）上的热门名字，也不是聚合网站的最爱。尽管预测休赛期很有趣，但多伦多蓝鸟在交易市场上一次又一次地给我们带来惊喜，所以最稳妥的押注可能就是神秘盲盒。
